jobs.title: Quality Platform Lead
jobs.description:
Quality Platform Lead

At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

Who we're looking for

We are looking for a hands-on Quality Platform Lead to own Vio's quality strategy and automation platform across web, mobile, browser extensions, internal tooling and related surfaces.

This is a technical leadership role (Staff IC) reporting to the Director of Engineering. You define what good looks like for quality, decide where scarce testing effort goes, and give teams the confidence to ship. Your levers are release gates, quality telemetry, and a developer experience that makes the right tests easy to write and keep alive.

Product engineers own the tests for the features they build. Your remit is the platform, the strategy and the enablement that make that work hold up at scale. There is no QA department here and we have no plans to create one.

Where you'll start

  • Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack

  • Mobile: Patrol (Flutter)

  • Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling

  • Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack

  • Mobile: Patrol (Flutter)

  • Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling

The tooling can stay as it is. With a clear case you can migrate or rebuild. E2E coverage today is thin, so a different platform is genuinely on the table if it serves speed, maintainability and DX better. We have no predefined answer.

AI-assisted tooling is an open area too. We have no established practice for agent-generated tests or AI-assisted triage, so your judgment on what earns a place in the platform carries real weight.

What we lack today is clear ownership of strategy, release gates and shared quality telemetry, plus a low-friction path for engineers to spend their testing effort on the highest-risk scenarios.

How the role works

Your time splits between hands-on platform work, enablement, strategy and stakeholder telemetry. One insourced QA Engineer supports you. You own the technical direction, the standards and the quality outcomes.

Once the platform has low friction, product engineers write and maintain the tests for the domains they own. You enable that through patterns, docs, reusable modules, CI checks and risk-based guidance. Gatekeeping releases sits outside the role.

Expect no direct people-management responsibilities in the near future. Any further QE hire gets evaluated against the ~1:50 rule once the value is proven, and we have no committed headcount plan beyond that.

What you'll own

Quality strategy and platform

  • Own the quality strategy and the automation platform across products, covering direction, standards and day-to-day health

  • Decide whether to keep, evolve or replace the current tooling, with clear trade-offs on speed, maintainability and DX

  • Set coding standards and patterns for test code, and keep the suite focused on the tests that earn their place

Release gates and telemetry

  • Build automated release gates into CI/CD and define what protects the core journeys

  • Give Product, Engineering and leadership real-time quality telemetry on release readiness, risk and pipeline health

  • Put failure triage and flaky-test quarantine in place, so every failure is worth acting on

Risk-based coverage and testability

  • Work with Product and Engineering to protect high-impact journeys and APIs

  • Retire flaky and low-value tests, and concentrate effort where the risk is highest

  • Act as the technical stakeholder for testability (hooks, mocks, contract tests, test data) and get those improvements onto team roadmaps

Developer enablement

  • Make it easy for product engineers to write, run and maintain tests locally and in CI

  • Embed quality into how teams plan and ship, and mentor the insourced QA Engineer

  • Drive a measurable increase in developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX

What success looks like in 12 months

  1. Platform ownership. You have taken over the automation platform across products and own it outright, with direction, standards and health all unambiguous, whether you kept the tooling or replaced it.

  2. Gates and focus. Release gates on the core journeys are fast and deterministic, and testing effort sits on the highest-risk scenarios.

  3. Dev ownership and satisfaction. Writing and maintaining tests is a routine part of Definition of Done, and developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX has measurably improved.

  4. Telemetry. Eng and Product work from live release-readiness and risk dashboards, failures triage cleanly, and flaky tests go into quarantine.

  5. Less manual drag. Regular releases go out without manual testing, with exploratory testing reserved for major new work.

Who you are

  • You have a track record of building or overhauling automation platforms (SWE / QE / SDET)

  • You write production-grade code across app, test and infra repos. Language matters less to us than depth, though our stack today leans on TypeScript/JS, Elixir, Go, Python and Dart.

  • You use AI agents effectively in your own engineering workflow and can judge where they belong inside a quality platform, from test generation to failure triage

  • You have cross-platform web and mobile automation judgment, and can weigh unified toolchains against separate ones objectively

  • You have deep CI/CD and test infrastructure experience: GitHub Actions, device clouds, parallelisation, test data

  • You can translate quality risk into telemetry and decisions that Eng, Product and leadership act on

  • You are a hands-on builder who wants to code the platform yourself

  • You design platforms developers adopt, and you prioritise risk-based coverage

Trade-offs we accept: depth on one platform when the other is learnable, and no travel or booking domain background.

Why join us now?

  • Full ownership of the quality strategy and the automation platform, with a mandate for enablement

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

  • We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;

  • We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency;

  • A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights);

  • Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely;

  • You will be part of a highly international team that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam;

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden;

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad;

  • A budget for your dream home office;

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp.

jobs.title: Care Account Manager (Clinical), Europe & West Africa
jobs.description:
Care Account Manager (Clinical), Europe & West Africa

The Role

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
  • Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
  • Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
  • Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
  • Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
  • Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

  • Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
  • Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
  • Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.

Requirements

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
  • Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
  • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
  • Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
  • Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
  • Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
  • Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.

Desirable

  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
  • Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
  • Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
  • Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

Graphic Designer & Video Editor Description

BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

What You'll Own

Email & Retention Design

Web Creative & CRO Support

What Success Looks Like

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Data Platform Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
  • Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
  • Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
  • Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
  • Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
  • Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

  • Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
  • Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
  • Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
  • Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

  • DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
  • Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
  • GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
  • Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
  • Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
  • Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

  • Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
  • Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
  • Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
  • Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
  • A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta.   • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

  • Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

  • Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (React Native, Swift or Kotlin), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

  • Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

  • Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Trust)
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Trust)

Beneath a simple yet elegant user interface lies a complex system of functionalities. Our AI-powered product uses advanced image recognition, facial verification, face recognition, facial anti-spoofing (liveness detection), and behavior analysis to make identity decisions. We help our partners build onboarding processes that ensure good people get things done and bad folks get stopped.

But knowing who someone is only gets you halfway. The next question is whether they can be trusted — and answering it means checking a person's identity data against the authoritative sources that hold the truth. Every country does this differently: a different registry, a different database, a different set of rules about what can be checked and how.

To take our platform to the next level, we're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Trust team. This team builds and operates the services that validate a person's identity data against country-specific authoritative sources — government registries, national databases, AML and sanctions screening — and turns that patchwork of very different upstreams into a single, dependable trust signal our customers can act on. Alongside sibling teams like Trust Registries and Trusted Documents, your work directly determines how many countries we can cover, how fast we can launch a new one, and how much our partners can rely on the answer we give them.

YOU'LL HELP US PROTECT HONEST PEOPLE ONLINE BY:

  • Designing, building, and operating Trust's backend services — the integrations with external identity data sources and the validation logic on top of them — with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability
  • Expanding our global coverage: onboarding new countries and data sources quickly, and building the abstractions that make the next integration cheaper than the last one instead of more expensive
  • Modelling messy, inconsistent upstream data into consistent, well-defined verification results — including the matching and validation rules that decide whether the data actually belongs to the person in front of us
  • Making our systems resilient to upstreams we don't control — timeouts, retries and idempotency, backpressure, circuit breaking, graceful degradation, backwards-compatibility testing, SPOF elimination, and end-to-end monitoring of every provider we depend on
  • Handling sensitive personal data responsibly, with regional data residency and compliance requirements designed in from the start
  • Participating in on-call rotations, incident response, and postmortems to ensure our most critical checks stay healthy
  • Driving engineering quality through code reviews, CI practices, runbook documentation, and mentoring teammates

YOU ARE THE RIGHT FUTURE VERIFFIAN FOR THE JOB IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years of experience building large-scale backend applications with Python, including event-driven and async architectures with message queues (e.g. SQS, RabbitMQ, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience integrating with third-party APIs at scale — and a healthy respect for what happens when they're slow, flaky, undocumented, or quietly change their response format
  • Proven ownership of production-critical services — you understand what it means to be on-call and take reliability seriously
  • Deep experience designing for resilience in distributed systems: idempotency, retries, backpressure, timeouts, backwards compatibility
  • Strong data modelling instincts — you can turn heterogeneous, inconsistent external data into a clean domain model that holds up as the number of sources grows
  • Strong understanding of modular design approaches and SOLID principles
  • Hands-on experience building scalable, maintainable APIs
  • Proficiency in a range of testing strategies that ensure robust and reliable software, including testing against external dependencies you can't fully control
  • Solid understanding of relational database fundamentals
  • Familiarity with structured logging and observability practices
  • Strong communication skills — you can clearly articulate technical ideas to engineers and non-engineers alike, and work comfortably with Product, Compliance, and external data providers

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with identity verification, KYC/AML, financial services, or government/registry integrationsExperience working under data privacy and regulatory constraints (GDPR, regional data residency)
  • Event-driven systems, workflow or orchestration engines, or Kubernetes

You can get familiar with our tech stack on StackShare.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.

When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include...

  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

Senior Systems Engineer

Location: Remote — South Asia (Open to applicants located anywhere in South Asia, with a preference for those based in IST or PKT time zones)

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.

As a Senior Systems Engineer at Fueled, you will join a team designing, deploying, and operating robust, scalable infrastructure platforms that support everything from small workloads to enterprise-scale client environments. You will bring deep expertise in modern infrastructure as code — Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and CDK — and an automation-first mindset to every layer of the stack.

You will architect and automate scalable cloud environments across AWS and Azure (with GCP and Oracle Cloud a plus), drive seamless CI/CD, and shape infrastructure through containerization and orchestration. With strong Linux fundamentals, you'll handle everything from bare-metal tuning to cloud-native service monitoring, debugging complex distributed systems, and producing the comprehensive documentation that keeps high-uptime platforms running.

Intentionally remote and globally distributed across six continents, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences.

What you will do:

  • Own cloud infrastructure end-to-end: You will architect, deploy, and manage highly available environments across AWS and Azure using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and CDK, and lead production Kubernetes workloads in EKS/AKS — including upgrades, networking, and autoscaling.
  • Serve as the Linux subject matter expert: You will own system builds, configure and troubleshoot core services like NGINX, MariaDB, and Redis, and drive performance, security, and reliability from the kernel up.
  • Operate the data and caching tier: You will run and scale MariaDB/Galera clusters alongside Redis, Memcached, and Elasticsearch, applying performance tuning and IaC-driven workflows to keep everything fast and resilient.
  • Engineer CI/CD and automation: You will build and tune pipelines in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Azure DevOps, and replace repetitive operational work with robust Python and Bash scripting that accelerates developer velocity.
  • Lead observability, security, and performance: You will evolve monitoring across metrics, logs, and traces, harden infrastructure security, participate in incident response and the 24/7 on-call rotation, and lead load-testing efforts that drive measurable platform improvements.

What you will achieve:

  • Week 1: You will seamlessly integrate with our engineering teams, auditing existing AWS/Azure architectures and CI/CD pipelines to understand our baseline operations and client workloads.
  • Month 1: You will be assisting with the 24/7 support on-call rotation and take ownership of core infrastructure deployments, standardize IaC practices, and begin tuning our Kubernetes clusters and Linux systems for optimal performance.
  • Month 6: You will have fully optimized and automated key deployment workflows, established highly available data tiers, and driven measurable improvements in security, observability, and overall platform reliability.
  • Team Impact: You will act as a critical bridge between systems and application teams, establishing robust platform engineering standards that support complex client workloads, including high-scale, highly available WordPress and headless setups.
  • Career Growth: You will establish yourself as a vital DevOps leader within the agency, shaping our multi-cloud strategy, heavily influencing infrastructure design, and elevating the technical standards of our operations.

About you:

  • You are a senior cloud infrastructure operator. You bring demonstrated senior-level experience in platform engineering or DevOps at scale or in multi-tenant environments, with strong hands-on AWS and Azure (multi-cloud preferred; GCP and Oracle Cloud a plus).
  • You are a Linux and IaC expert. You can set up, tune, troubleshoot, and harden Linux systems at a deep level, and you've taken Terraform, Ansible, Helm, or CDK projects from greenfield through long-term management.
  • You run production Kubernetes and data services. You have proven experience operating EKS/AKS — upgrades, networking, troubleshooting, Kubernetes PodWeaver — and managing production-grade NGINX, MariaDB/Galera, Redis/Memcached, and Elasticsearch.
  • You automate relentlessly and ship pipelines that scale. You write advanced Python and/or Bash, and you've built and tuned CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, GitLab, or similar tools with a strong grasp of modern observability tooling and security best practices.
  • You communicate clearly and show up for the team. You write excellent documentation, work well with clients, bridge systems and application teams (including high-scale, highly available WordPress hosting and headless setups), and are available for a 24/7 support rotation.

Benefits & Salary

We offer competitive salaries and benefits. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, other job-related qualifications, geographic location, and business needs.

Full Stack Software Engineer
IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
  • Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
  • Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.

  • Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
  • Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
  • Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
  • Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
  • Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.


YOUR PROFILE

  • Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
  • Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
  • Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
  • Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
  • Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
  • High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
  • Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
  • Valid work permit or Swiss passport.


OUR BENEFITS

  • Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
  • Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
  • 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation 
  • Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
  • We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund
  • New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.
  • We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
  • Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
  • Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions
 
Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. 
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

Member of Technical Staff (m/f/d)

Who We Are:

We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across multiple industries—empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities.

Overview:

We are looking for a world-class robotics professionals to join our R&D hub in the Zurich area. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that enable robots to understand and interact with the world with unprecedented generalization. You will work on the intersection of large-scale foundation models and real-world robotic execution, bridging the gap between state-of-the-art research and deployed embodied intelligence.

Your Responsibilities:

Research & Development:

  • Design, implement, and scale VLA models and foundation architectures for robotic manipulation and navigation.

Scaling Laws & Data:

  • Develop strategies for multi-modal data collection, synthetic data generation, and efficient fine-tuning of large-scale models.

Algorithm Optimization:

  • Optimize model inference for real-time robotic applications without compromising reasoning capabilities.

Publication & Visibility:

  • Contribute to the global research community by publishing high-impact papers at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, CVPR, ICRA, CoRL, etc.).

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with the Core Robotics and Hardware teams to integrate AI models into our physical platforms.

Qualifications:

Academic Excellence:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field, with a focus on Deep Learning and Computer Vision.

Proven Research Track Record:

  • Significant publications and citations at major conferences such as NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, IROS, or CoRL.

Professional Background:

  • Experience working in leading AI research environments

Technical Mastery:

  • Deep expertise in PyTorch or JAX, experience with Transformers, Diffusion Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Domain Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Vision-Language models and their application to Action/Control loops in robotics.

Location:

Zurich Area, Switzerland:

  • This role is based in our Zurich office, offering a vibrant ecosystem for robotics and AI.

What We Offer:

  • Free meals at the workplace.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home when needed.

  • Direct collaboration with founders and world-leading AI experts.

  • A key role in shaping the future of embodied AI.

Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation.
Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities.

jobs.description:
(Senior) Programmatic Sales GSA

YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

As a Programmatic Sales GSA, you will be responsible for the automated and data-driven sale of our digital advertising inventory (primarily video and CTV) and report directly to the Director Sales All Markets. You will manage programmatic bookings, oversee the planning, implementation and optimisation of our initiatives to boost revenue in programmatic sales, and will therefore also be directly responsible for the optimisation and smooth, technical implementation of campaigns. This makes you the primary point of contact for agency trading desks in the GSA region regarding preferred deals and PMP strategies. You’ll also help with SSP and header bidding integrations and act as the link between Sales, Tech and AdOps.

THE ADS TEAM

The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. With a presence in two countries (based in Berlin, Hamburg and Zurich) and operations in six countries, the Ads Team is a key driver of growth within Zattoo and has established itself as the market leader in CTV in Switzerland within a year.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand.
  • Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals.
  • Maximise inventory revenue, skilfully manage floor prices (minimum prices) and analyse delivery rates and CPMs.
  • Partner with regional sales teams in GSA to consult clients and pitch programmatic solutions.
  • Co-lead the technical and commercial setup of Header Bidding and additional SSP integrations for CTV.
  • First-line technical ownership of programmatic delivery.
  • Identify technical errors during delivery, analyse tracking issues and check campaign set-ups: troubleshoot deal delivery, floor pricing, and DSP configuration issues (e.g., SSAI, VAST responses, pod management, DSP/SSP bid stream mismatches).
  • Explain complex technical matters in simple terms to non-technical customers or internal departments.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 4+ years of experience in Programmatic Advertising, SSP Management, or Programmatic Account Management (strong experience in CTV/Video)
  • A proven track record in the sales of digital advertising products
  • Deep understanding of Google Ad Manager, DSP/SSP workflows, OpenRTB specs, and deal types (Preferred Deals, PMP, PG)
  • Experience or strong technical familiarity with Header Bidding frameworks (e.g., Prebid) and SSP integrations
  • Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape
  • Fluent in German and English
  • Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills

jobs.description:
Technical Customer Support

QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

  • Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
  • Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

  • Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

  • Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

  • Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

  • Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
  • Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
  • The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

  • Contract type: full-time or part-time
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable

  • Bring and reinforce good engineering habits in the team: automated testing at several levels, CI/CD, pull requests and code review, and clear documentation.

  • Contribute to operational excellence: observability, monitoring, data quality, and secure data handling.

The experience you bring

  • 3 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience, building and operating systems in production.

  • Strong Python and strong SQL, with clean, readable code and a good sense for data modelling.

  • Proven engineering discipline: you write tests (unit, integration, data quality), work with CI/CD, and use pull requests and code review as a matter of course, and you can show how you helped a team adopt them.

Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Product Owner (Microsoft, Koddex, outils collaboratifs)

Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de la DSI d'Exotec, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille d'outils collaboratifs utilisés par nos Exopeople répartis en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.

Votre mission consistera à définir la vision, piloter l'évolution et maximiser l'adoption des solutions collaboratives qui soutiennent les activités de l'entreprise. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'écosystème Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot, etc.) ainsi que sur Koddex, plateforme stratégique pour le partage des connaissances et la gestion de nos processus internes.

Véritable interface entre les métiers, les équipes IT et les partenaires externes, vous accompagnerez la transformation digitale d'Exotec en proposant des solutions à forte valeur ajoutée pour les utilisateurs.

Vos missions

Définir et piloter la stratégie produit

  • Porter la vision des outils collaboratifs et définir une roadmap cohérente avec les priorités métiers, la stratégie IT et les ambitions de transformation digitale d’Exotec.
  • Être responsable de la valeur produite par le portefeuille, en reliant chaque évolution à un résultat attendu pour les utilisateurs et l’entreprise.
  • Arbitrer les priorités du portefeuille en tenant compte de l’impact utilisateur, de l’adoption attendue, des contraintes techniques, des risques et de la soutenabilité des solutions.

Recueillir, challenger et prioriser les besoins

  • Être responsable de la discovery produit en recueillant des besoins de terrain auprès des utilisateurs, des métiers, de la DSI et des relais locaux en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.
  • Challenger les demandes et distinguer les besoins structurants des préférences locales, en s’appuyant sur les données d’usage, les retours utilisateurs et l’impact business.
  • Garantir que les décisions de priorisation et de roadmap reposent sur des éléments objectifs, des résultats mesurables et une compréhension réelle des usages.

Piloter les évolutions et les déploiements

  • Piloter le cycle complet des évolutions, de leur cadrage jusqu’à leur mise à disposition, en garantissant la qualité, la sécurité, l’intégration et la valeur délivrée.
  • Définir les critères de réussite et les standards de qualité des solutions, afin de sécuriser leur déploiement dans l’écosystème Exotec.
  • Prendre les décisions de release et de cycle de vie en équilibrant valeur utilisateur, risques opérationnels, dépendances éditeurs et pérennité des plateformes.

Développer l’adoption et animer la gouvernance

  • Définir et porter la stratégie d’adoption des outils collaboratifs afin d’ancrer durablement de nouveaux usages, au-delà de la seule communication ou de la formation.
  • Être responsable de l’adoption effective, de la satisfaction des utilisateurs et de la réduction des irritants qui limitent l’usage de Microsoft 365 et de Koddex.
  • Aligner les métiers, la DSI, les utilisateurs clés, les éditeurs et les partenaires externes sur les priorités, les règles de gouvernance, les arbitrages et les résultats attendus.
  • Piloter la relation avec les éditeurs et partenaires stratégiques, en maîtrisant leurs engagements, leur feuille de route, leurs risques et leurs contraintes commerciales dans l’intérêt d’Exotec.
  • Garantir la cohérence, la rationalisation et l’évolution maîtrisée du portefeuille d’outils collaboratifs et de l’écosystème de connaissances.

Votre profil

  • Expérience en Product Ownership, gestion de produit ou transformation digitale.
  • Bonne connaissance des outils collaboratifs, idéalement Microsoft 365.
  • Appétence pour les environnements SaaS et la conduite du changement.
  • Capacité à faire le lien entre enjeux métiers et solutions techniques.
  • Maîtrise des méthodes Agile.
  • Anglais professionnel.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Business Intelligence Analyst

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions.

You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization
  • Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics
  • Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly
  • Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests
  • Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource
  • Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions
  • Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences
  • Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions
  • Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data
  • Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments
  • Experience in a high-growth environment
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred)
  • Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations

Why This Role Matters

Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust.

Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day.

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Performance Task — 60 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more.   • Build end-to-end by designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving scalable microservices and features.
  • Own what you deliver, taking responsibility for the quality, resilience, and maintainability of your team’s services throughout their lifecycle.
  • Collaborate across disciplines while closely working with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile engineers to share ideas and deliver product innovations.
  • Improve how we work, identifying opportunities to make our engineering processes more effective and efficient.
  • Strengthen our engineering culture by documenting and advocating for development best practices across the team.
  • Raise product quality by fixing bugs and refactoring the codebase where necessary to keep our products reliable and maintainable.
  • Learn and experiment by testing new technologies and participating in Technical Week - a week dedicated to creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains after every two product sprints.

What You'll Bring

You understand the full lifecycle of web development, identify opportunities, explore solutions, and keep customer needs at the center of your work. Our stack is mainly focused on Ruby; however, prior Ruby experience is not essential if you’re passionate about learning new things.

  • Strong software engineering foundations: 7+ years of software development experience, specifically with object-oriented programming.
  • Relevant product experience: 3+ years of experience working with customer-facing products in industries such as e-commerce, fintech, or SaaS.
  • Backend service expertise: Experience designing, implementing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and consistency.
  • API and data knowledge: A good understanding of API design, SQL, and relational databases.
  • Clear communication: Excellent English communication skills and comfort raising concerns, sharing ideas, and documenting your work.
  • Collaborative mindset: You contribute to the team, take initiative, and step in to help when needed.
  • Solution-oriented thinking: You actively identify opportunities and explore alternative approaches to solving problems.
  • Commitment to growth: You take ownership of developing your skills by learning new technologies and seeking new opportunities.

How We Work

Our engineers work in small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile teams aligned with one of three verticals: Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment.

  • Teams are responsible for their own microservices from design and development through deployment, maintenance, and improvement.
  • Engineers collaborate closely with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile colleagues.
  • We value bold thinking, curiosity, openness, initiative, and a strong customer focus.
  • Technical Week creates dedicated space for experimentation, creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains.

Where You'll Be

This is a Hybrid role based in Lisbon. You will work from our Lisbon Hub a minimum of 2 days per week.
At this time, we are only considering candidates who are already based in Portugal. As a result, visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position.

In Return

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians.

  • A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.
  • Meal Allowance Card stipend per working day, in addition to salary.
  • Health Insurance from day 1 (including dental coverage), with access to multiple hospitals and clinics and a vast wellness network.
  • A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.
  • Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.
  • Amazing Office right in the centre of Lisbon.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
