jobs.description:
Investment Director (Diagnostics) - Lyon, France

Location : Lyon, France

ABOUT ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, the US and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare. Our mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise positions us as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Priority areas include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services.

ARCHIMED manages $11 billion across its funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based GP. MED I, MED II and MED Platform I are all top-decile performers for their vintage according to Preqin data. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

THE TEAM

  • An global team with complementary backgrounds across investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational disciplines.
  • Alumni of INSEAD, Wharton, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, École des Ponts ParisTech, ESSEC, Imperial College and Dartmouth, among others.
  • Professional backgrounds spanning Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, Capiton, Partners Group, KKR), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC, Goldman Sachs, Jefferies) and Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Stryker, Phillips, Pfizer, Baxter, LivaNova, J&J, Galderma, Sanofi).

THE DIAGNOSTICS TEAM

The Director will serve as a senior investment professional with direct responsibility for sourcing, evaluating and executing investments across the Diagnostics portfolio. The Director will lead deal activity across an assigned geography, technology platform or investment theme, and will carry accountability for investment outcomes, value creation and portfolio company support.

This is a senior operating role combining strategic direction setting with hands-on deal execution, positioning the Director as a trusted senior advisor to Partners and portfolio management teams.

  • Investment Sourcing & Strategy
    • Drive sourcing and pipeline development across assigned Diagnostics sectors or geographies, identifying and cultivating relationships with sellers, intermediaries and LP co-investors.
    • Lead the formation and evolution of investment theses within assigned focus areas, including category mapping, competitive positioning and market trend analysis.
    • Serve as primary investment decision maker and deal sponsor, with direct accountability for investment committee presentations and recommendation.
    • Lead the negotiation of transaction terms, pricing and deal structure in partnership with Partners and external advisors.
  • Due Diligence & Execution
    • Oversee comprehensive commercial, financial and operational due diligence, working with external advisors to validate assumptions and identify key risks and levers.
    • Lead the development of post-acquisition value creation roadmaps, including 100-day plans and multi-year operating strategies.
    • Manage the investment committee approval process and coordinate all transaction closing mechanics with legal and finance teams.
  • Portfolio Leadership & Value Creation
    • Serve as the primary investment relationship owner for assigned portfolio companies, working directly with management teams on strategy, M&A, capital deployment and operational priorities.
    • Lead add-on acquisition identification, evaluation and execution, including syndication with co-investors.
    • Drive performance monitoring and problem-solving, escalating key decisions to Partners and intervention areas to senior management.
    • Sponsor and mentor portfolio company boards, ensuring robust governance and strategic clarity.
  • Team & Platform Development
    • Mentor and develop Senior Analysts and Associate-level team members, contributing to talent development and succession planning within the Diagnostics function.
    • Contribute to ARCHIMED's Diagnostics thought leadership and external positioning through conference participation, investor communication and industry engagement.
    • Identify and build capabilities across the Diagnostics platform to support scaling and evolution of the investment program.

Requirements

  • 8 to 12 years of investment or operating experience, with a strong track record in private equity investing, transaction execution or operational leadership within diagnostics sector.
  • Demonstrated success originating, evaluating and closing significant investments (€50 million+ enterprise value preferred), with evidence of value creation across the portfolio.
  • Deep expertise in the Diagnostics landscape, including brand strategy, omnichannel distribution, and regulatory dynamics .
  • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills. Able to command credibility with sophisticated management teams, institutional LPs and external partners.
  • Strong financial acumen and fluency with investment modeling, valuation and deal structuring. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills required.
  • Proven operational judgment and the ability to translate market insights into concrete investment theses and deal opportunities.
  • Track record of building and leading high-performing teams. Comfort with mentoring junior professionals and shaping investment culture.
  • Strategic, entrepreneurial and partnership-minded. Takes ownership of outcomes, moves with pace and brings a builder's orientation to platform development.
  • Advanced degree preferred. MBA or equivalent experience strongly valued.
  • Embodies and reinforces ARCHIMED's cultural values of inclusion, meritocracy, partnership, accountability, client focus and trust.

Wozu brauchen wir diese Stelle?

Die Luft- und Seefracht ist ein wichtiger Wachstumsbereich der ZUFALL logistics group.   • Du setzt die Vertriebsstrategie für den Bereich Luft- und Seefracht (Air & Sea) gemeinsam mit dem Senior Manager Air & Sea um

  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfolge in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Kundenumsätzen erzielt
  • Du schaffst es dich schnell in ein internationales Partnernetzwerk einzubringen

Hamburg mit der Option auf mobiles Arbeiten an 2-3 Tagen die Woche; 
dazu kommen Dienstreise je nach Bedarf

flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Schneller Einstieg durch einen bestehenden Lead-Pool und gezielte Vertriebsunterstützung

  • Spannende Kundenprojekte entlang globaler Lieferketten
  • Viel Gestaltungsfreiheit, Eigenverantwortung und Raum für Deinen persönlichen Vertriebserfolg
  • Persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung mit langfristigen Perspektiven innerhalb der ZUFALL logistics group
  • Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Bike-Leasing und weitere standortspezifische Angebote

jobs.description:
Corporate Account Executive (x/f/m) - DACH
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

What will you do:
  • Lead the full sales-cycle, from prospecting to initial interest to deal close and coordinate collaboration cross-functionally with customer success, technical teams, etc.
  • Driving a complex sales cycle, involving internal and external stakeholders like integrators.
  • Create detailed business plans designed to attain predetermined goals and quotas
  • Build relationships with executives at all levels and in all industries, in order to close deals (corporate organisations)
  • Consult with prospects and existing customers regarding business objectives and requirements, and build long-lasting partnerships (corporate organisations)
  • Model a wide range of use cases in which Pigment can drive business transformation across different industries
  • Provide professional after-sales support with our CSM team to maximise customer loyalty
  • Negotiate agreements and keep records of sales and data in Salesforce
  • Think critically about sales insights and data and experiment with new growth tactics.
    •  

    Who are you:
  • You have first hand experience as a B2B Account Executive or similar sales role in SaaS B2B or finance product
  • You have extensive experience in prospecting, opening and developing a corporate market across DACH.
  • You have experience with MEDDICC sales qualification methodology;
  • You thrive partnering with business leaders and executives, developing long-term relationships, closing deals, and aligning key stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle
  • You have an affinity for tech and product issues and / or a relevant experience in finance or business planning
  • You have a deep track record of creating significant revenue impact and deep relationships for your organisation
  • You are a resourceful, resilient, creative problem-solver when faced with the business needs of your clients, and understanding how Pigment plugs into the bigger picture for them.
  • Speak fluent German and English, any other languages would be a great advantage
  • Bonus points for experience selling to the Swiss market!

    • What we offer:
  • Competitive package
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth

    • How we work:
  • Champion our Customer: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organizations
  • Thrive Together:  We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
  • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day.  Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
  • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
  • Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment

Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
     
    Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. jobs.description:
Director, Business Development

About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

jobs.title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
jobs.description:
Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Diabolocom is the leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience management (CX) platform. It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel. 
 
Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth.


About the role

To support our growth, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our HR team in Paris.

You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire.

A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions.

You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role.

You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department.

We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices.


What you will do

  • Manage recruitment processes from A to Z, from the initial briefing with the hiring manager through sourcing, interviews, coordination of the selection process, offer management and contract signature.

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, challenge requirements when relevant and translate them into an effective recruitment and sourcing strategy.

  • Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles, including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles.

  • Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting, identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications.

  • Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches.

  • Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment.

  • Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process.

  • Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience.

  • Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process.

  • Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators.

  • Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes.

  • Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices.


    • What we are looking for

  • You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment.

  • You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team.

  • You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant.

  • You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach.

  • Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels.

  • You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly.

  • You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders.

  • You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals.

  • You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices.

  • You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers.

    • What's in it for you

  • A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture.

  • Exposure to an international environment and stakeholders across multiple countries.

  • A Talent Acquisition team where you can operate autonomously while continuing to learn and develop your expertise.

This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Reliability Engineer

Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, composée de 6 ingénieurs, vous contribuez à améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la disponibilité des systèmes robotiques Exotec.

Notre mission : exploiter les données et analyser les défaillances pour améliorer la robustesse et la durée de vie de nos systèmes, tout en réduisant les arrêts opérationnels.

À l’interface entre hardware et software, vous identifiez les causes racines des défaillances, développez des outils d’analyse et pilotez des améliorations techniques. Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du système, de l’analyse des données terrain au développement et à la validation de solutions concrètes.

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, vos missions sont les suivantes :

  • Analyser les défaillances et améliorer la fiabilité : exploiter les données terrain, identifier les principaux modes de panne, rechercher les causes racines et définir des actions correctives et préventives.
  • Développer des outils d’analyse : concevoir vos propres outils software pour exploiter les données, diagnostiquer les problèmes et évaluer les performances des systèmes.
  • Développer et tester des solutions logicielles : réaliser des développements de software embarqué en autonomie afin de tester vos améliorations et de résoudre des problématiques à l’interface entre hardware et software.
  • Contribuer à l’évolution des systèmes : travailler avec les équipes de conception pour améliorer les composants, les sous-systèmes et les architectures hardware.
  • Concevoir et réaliser des essais : définir des protocoles de test, mener des expérimentations sur des systèmes dédiés à la R&D et mesurer l’efficacité des améliorations apportées.
  • Enrichir votre connaissance des systèmes sur le terrain : participer au support client pour mieux comprendre les conditions d’utilisation, investiguer les problèmes rencontrés et identifier de nouvelles pistes d’amélioration.

Votre profil

  • Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation supérieure technique en mécatronique, systèmes embarqués, génie industriel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou vous avez acquis une expérience équivalente.
  • Vous avez une expérience en conception, développement ou validation de systèmes techniques et manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche de panne et l’analyse des causes racines.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils de développement, le versioning et l’analyse de données.
  • Vous appréciez les problématiques à l’interface entre software et hardware et êtes capable de comprendre les interactions entre les différents composants d’un système.
  • Vous êtes familier(ère) avec les méthodes quantitatives appliquées à la fiabilité : MTTF, MTBF, loi de Weibull ou analyse statistique des défaillances.
  • Vous êtes curieux(se), structuré(e) et rigoureux(se), avec une approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes.
  • Vous savez remettre en question vos hypothèses, approfondir vos analyses et rechercher de nouvelles connaissances lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Vous aimez collaborer avec des ingénieurs aux expertises variées, qu’elles soient orientées hardware, software ou systèmes.
  • Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

jobs.description:
Psychotherapeut:in (a) - Digital Health/Basel (40-100%)

Standort: Hybrid (Stadt Basel & Home Office)
Anstellung: Festanstellung mit viel Freiheiten und Selbstbestimmung

Pensum: 40-100%
Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

 

Du willst nicht einfach nur behandeln, sondern etwas bewegen?
Dann bist Du bei Oviva genau richtig.

 

Warum Oviva?

 

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen nachhaltige, personalisierte, klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in Grossbritannien, der Schweiz, Deutschland und Polen unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Jedes Gespräch und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte diese Zukunft aktiv mit.

 

Die Stelle

 

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang

 

Menschen mit Adipositas sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patient*innen leiden zusätzlich unter psychischen oder neu divergenten Herausforderungen wie ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depression, Angststörungen oder Binge-Eating-Störungen.
Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

 

Bei Oviva greifen wir Themen auf, die viele unserer Patient*innen beschäftigen – wie Selbstbild, hormonelle Veränderungen, Elternschaft, Belastung im Alltag oder emotionale Essmuster. In der Psychotherapie bei Oviva dürfen all diese Themen ihren Platz haben.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du arbeitest interdisziplinär mit Ernährungsberaterinnen & Ärztinnen zusammen.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

  • Du bringst aktiv Ideen und Vorschläge mit, wie wir als Team uns weiterentwickeln können.

Dein Profil

  • eidg. anerkannte Psychotherapeut/in

  • Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C

  • Drei Jahr klinische Erfahrung

  • Leidenschaft für digitale, patientenzentrierte Versorgung

  • Offenheit, Neues zu gestalten – und Altes zu hinterfragen

  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit


Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die Gesundheitsversorgung für Menschen mit Adipositas und Typ-2-Diabetes revolutioniert.

  • Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

 

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung. Weitere Informationen findest Du auf unserer Homepage: https://oviva.com/ch/de/psychotherapie/.

 

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:
Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich

 

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Wir begrüßen und ermutigen Bewerber*innen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidat*innen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.

 

Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidat*innen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen

 

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!

jobs.title: Director, Corporate Counsel
jobs.description:
Director, Corporate Counsel

Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As Director, Corporate Counsel at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together.

What are we looking for?

We're seeking a business-oriented, proactive, and collaborative attorney to join BetterHelp’s Legal team to support both our BetterHelp Business (B2B) and Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) operations.

The ideal candidate will have experience in the B2B partnership landscape, including employee assistance programs (EAPs), health plans, and enterprise partnerships. You’ll play a key role in structuring, negotiating, and implementing partnership and marketing agreements, ensuring that our B2B offerings and D2C platform work seamlessly together.

This role requires someone who can think strategically about how to operationalize partnerships, translating legal agreements into effective business processes, and who thrives in a cross-functional environment working with sales, product, marketing, and engineering. A background in healthcare or digital health contracting, particularly in models that blend enterprise and consumer delivery, is a plus.

What will you do?

  • Support our B2B team by drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a wide range of B2B and enterprise agreements, including Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, reseller, referral, and vendor agreements.
  • Support and advise on EAP, employer, and health plan partnership arrangements, helping structure offerings that extend BetterHelp’s D2C care model to new populations through enterprise partnerships.
  • Collaborate with marketing, partnerships, product, and business development teams.
  • Negotiate marketing, sponsorship, and affiliate agreements, including campaigns with influencers, content creators, and third-party wellness platforms, ensuring compliance with healthcare and advertising regulations.
  • Partner with sales and operations to design and operationalize new partnership frameworks, ensuring that legal, business, and technical requirements are fully aligned.
  • Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and compliance teams to ensure contractual commitments are supported by product functionality and service delivery standards.
  • Provide legal guidance on data privacy, information security, and healthcare regulatory compliance, including HIPAA, FTC, and state-specific health and marketing laws.
  • Monitor and interpret evolving laws, regulations, and industry standards impacting digital health, mental health parity, telehealth, and enterprise wellness.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.
  • You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.
  • You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.
  • You will NOT be expected to put your well-being aside to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, while supporting sustainable ways of working.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

Requirements

  • 7- 10 years of relevant legal experience.
  • 3+ years of healthcare related legal work experience.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an ABA-accredited U.S. law school and active member in good standing of a U.S. state bar.
  • You must be egoless, value collaboration, and be ready to put in the hard work to accomplish whatever the job demands.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills is a must.
  • Ability to provide practical, risk-balanced legal advice in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
  • Collaborative and adaptable mindset with a focus on enabling business growth while maintaining compliance.
  • Experience working in a hybrid organization offering both D2C and B2B services and/or digital health platform is preferred, but not required.
  • Digital and privacy experience is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Holistic well-being benefits, including free therapy and employee wellness programs
  • Remote flexibility with company-sponsored opportunities to connect in person
  • The chance to build something that changes lives— and that people love
  • The hardware and software you need to do your best work
  • An awesome community of coworkers

The base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $215,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications.

At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status.

Notice to Candidates:
BetterHelp is aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating our Talent Acquisition team. All open roles are posted on our official careers page or verified BetterHelp pages on reputable job boards, and legitimate BetterHelp emails will come from an @betterhelp.com address.
BetterHelp will never ask candidates for money, gift cards, payment, or to cash or deposit checks as part of our hiring process. If you receive such a request, it is a scam.

jobs.title: Principal Customer Success Manager - Pharma
jobs.description:
Principal Customer Success Manager - Pharma

At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co to learn more about us.

H1’s Customer Success team is focused on building deep, trusted relationships with existing customers to ensure they successfully implement the H1 platform, drive sustained engagement, and realize measurable business value from our solutions.

WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1
The primary objective of the Principal Customer Success Manager is to serve as a strategic, trusted advisor to a portfolio of H1’s largest and most complex customers. You will own the customer relationship end-to-end, partnering closely with both senior client stakeholders and users to drive adoption, value realization, retention, and growth across either H1’s Clinical or Medical & Commercial product lines.

This role is designed for a highly autonomous, principal-level Customer Success leader who thrives in ambiguity, independently owns complex customer programs, strong personal accountability, and influences outcomes across customers, partners, and internal teams. Success in this role requires exceptional judgment, executive presence, and the ability to lead without direct authority.

You will:
- Own large-scale customer programs involving multiple business units, internal teams, System Integrators (SIs), and executive stakeholders.
- Lead cross-functional initiatives by establishing governance, driving accountability, managing dependencies, and ensuring successful execution across internal and external teams.
- Operate as the strategic point of contact for complex customer engagements, aligning competing priorities while driving measurable business outcomes and managing the overall account.
- Lead multiple concurrent, cross-functional customer programs, balancing competing priorities across customer executives, implementation partners, and internal stakeholders while maintaining alignment on strategic objectives.
- Build strong relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders, positioning H1 as a critical partner in achieving their organizational goals.
- Operate with minimal oversight while independently prioritizing competing customer and business needs.
- Exercise sound judgment in highly ambiguous situations where there may not be an established playbook.
- Identify gaps, define solutions, and drive execution without requiring direction from leadership.
- Successfully navigate complex stakeholder dynamics during periods of organizational change or customer escalation.
- Own and drive account strategy, including implementation and adoption plans, success metrics, renewal readiness, and expansion opportunities.
- Lead regular executive business reviews, clearly articulating performance against KPIs, ROI, and strategic impact.
- Serve as the voice of the customer internally, providing structured feedback to product, engineering, and leadership teams to inform roadmap and prioritization.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support to ensure a seamless customer experience across the full lifecycle.
- Consistently drive improvements in MAUs, NPS, CSAT, retention, and ARR across your book of business.
- Proactively identify and mitigate risk across all areas of the account.

ABOUT YOU
We’re looking for a Principal Customer Success Manager who is passionate about delivering measurable value to enterprise customers at scale. You bring a strategic mindset, strong executive presence, and the ability to balance deep problem-solving with long-term relationship management. You thrive in fast-paced environments and take pride in owning outcomes for your customers.
- You quickly establish credibility and require little ramp-up to begin managing strategic customer relationships in the Pharma & CRO space.
- You naturally create structure in ambiguous environments and enjoy solving complex organizational challenges.
- You have exceptional ownership and accountability, following through on commitments without requiring close oversight.
- You are known for bringing order to difficult customer situations and driving successful outcomes.
- You influence without authority and effectively lead cross-functional teams toward shared objectives.

REQUIREMENTS
- 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Program Management, or equivalent strategic customer-facing experience within an Enterprise or Strategic B2B SaaS environment.
- Demonstrated experience owning complex, high-ARR accounts with senior stakeholder engagement.
- Strong project management experience across multi-threaded, high-priority initiatives.
- Experience working in or with Life Sciences organizations strongly preferred; Medical Affairs or Clinical experience is a plus.
- Proven ability to manage renewals, mitigate risk, and identify expansion opportunities.

COMPENSATION
This role pays $145,000 to $160,000 per year, based on experience, plus variable commission, based on performance, in addition to stock options.

Anticipated role close date: 09/21/2026

Compensation

Additional Information

H1 OFFERS

- Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off

- Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays

- Retirement options

- Health & charitable donation stipends

Senior Technical Product Manager (Biometric Authentication)

Veriff is building the foundational trust layer of the internet, empowering people to safely and privately prove they are who they say they are. Our identity verification platform powers onboarding and authentication for some of the world's largest marketplaces, fintechs, and platforms. Biometric Authentication is our second-largest product, and it's how we move customers from one-time identity checks to continuous, lifecycle-long trust.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Biometric Authentication turns every verified user into an ongoing, secure relationship: silent re-verification, step-up authentication, and fraud prevention at the moments that matter. The product runs in production at enterprise scale, with real cost, conversion, and latency consequences for major customers.

As this product has grown into a multi-product area, we're hiring a Senior PM to take primary ownership of Biometric Authentication: driving customer research, competitive roadmap strategy, and pricing, in close partnership with machine learning, engineering, design, sales, and GTM. In this role, you'll be expected to operate autonomously with low management overhead, default to cross-functional collaboration, and are comfortable experimenting and shipping fast. You'll bring enough context and judgement to make commercial trade-offs without waiting for direction. You'll be at your best in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and on distributed, international teams.

This is a role for a PM who treats adoption, conversion, and revenue as their own problem, not one who manages a feature backlog and waits for commercial direction.

You’ll help us protect honest people online by:

  • Own the product end-to-end. Take primary ownership of Biometric Authentication: strategy, roadmap, and execution — across a cross-functional squad of ML, engineering, and design.
  • Own a commercial metric. Pick up a revenue, adoption, or conversion metric, diagnose the gap, and design the customer research and process changes to close it alongside sales and GTM.
  • Make decisions at scale. Reason about trade-offs in cost, conversion, and latency against live enterprise contracts, in real production conditions, on a regular basis.
  • Run a tight customer-feedback loop. Turn enterprise customer feedback into a prioritized, defensible roadmap.
  • Own competitive positioning and pricing. Track the biometric and identity landscape and shape packaging and pricing grounded in real unit economics.
  • Operate with high agency. Get to independent operation within ~60 days and start clearing the highest-impact work early.

You are the right future Veriffian for the job if you have:

  • A technical background and fluent with technical systems: distributed transactional systems, machine learning, operational metrics, COGS, and SDK delivery. (Ability to program is a plus; you won't be building ML models but you should be able to do query, debug and do root cause analysis independently)
  • Experience thriving in a scale-up: high ambiguity, fast pace, and challenging environments.
  • Strong understanding of B2B2C user experience: fluency in the end-user experience inside a business product.
  • ~5+ years of product management experience.
  • Experience in fintech or marketplace products.
  • Background in authentication, security, or identity.
  • Ability to program is a plus; you won't be building ML models but you should be able to do query, debug and do root cause analysis independently)
  • Previous Software Engineering / Data Science development experience

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career whilst looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favourites include...

Staff Full Stack Engineer

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Technology sits at the centre of Allica. We design and build the platforms that power the bank, working closely with every part of the business to deliver real impact for customers. Our teams move quickly, focus on outcomes, and take ownership from concept through to delivery. We solve complex problems, modernise processes, and enable the business to scale with confidence.

What makes us different is the level of influence and autonomy engineers have. We work without the weight of legacy systems, which means we can focus on building for the future. Everyone contributes ideas and helps shape how we operate, and roles evolve as the organisation grows. This is a place for people who want to have a tangible impact and do their best work in a modern, collaborative environment.

Role Description

The Staff Full Stack Engineer is responsible for setting technical direction across multiple squads, typically overseeing 2–3 squads and line-managing 3–5 Full Stack Engineers. The role exists to shape architecture, ensure the success of these squads, and drive consistent, secure, and compliant delivery across Allica’s digital products.

You will use your expertise in Spring Boot microservices (Java/Kotlin) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript) to define and evolve cross-squad patterns, shared tooling, and platform capabilities.

Our backend microservices are containerised and deployed to Azure Container Apps, and our web applications are deployed to Azure Static Web Apps; you will help define and uphold the standards that make these platforms robust, cost-effective, and easy to operate.

You will own key cross-cutting concerns such as authentication, observability, performance, accessibility, and regulatory compliance, ensuring our systems meet the standards expected of a UK bank.

You are hands-on: you design and review architectures, pair with engineers, and contribute code to high-impact initiatives.

You work closely with Product, Design and other engineering leaders to align technical direction with business goals and to unblock delivery.

You drive the responsible adoption of GenAI and agentic engineering practices (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), setting organisation-wide standards and measuring impact.

Success in this role is reflected in simpler architectures, improved delivery consistency and reliability, stronger engineering effectiveness, and the growth and performance of your direct reports and squads.

Principal Accountabilities

Set and evolve cross-squad technical patterns and guardrails for:

  • Backend services (Kotlin/Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/OpenAPI, messaging, integrations).

  • Frontend architectures (React/TypeScript, shared design system, Nx, micro frontends where appropriate).

  • Authentication/authorisation, API gateways and API governance (versioning, contracts, deprecation).

  • Own platform-level technical initiatives that reduce complexity and duplication, including shared libraries, design system tokens, infrastructure templates, observability frameworks, and code/scaffolding templates.

  • Define and maintain organisation-wide standards for performance, reliability, security, accessibility, and operational excellence, in partnership with Architecture, InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance.

  • Establish and improve SLOs, error budget policies, and incident management practices across key services; lead post-incident reviews and drive follow-through on structural fixes.

  • Lead cross-squad system design for complex initiatives, ensuring coherent architectures, well-managed dependencies, clear domain boundaries, and effective interactions between services and frontends.

  • Shape and continuously improve cloud-native deployment patterns on Azure (Container Apps, Static Web Apps, networking, configuration, and scaling), working closely with Platform Engineering teams.

  • Drive improvements to developer experience (CI/CD, local development workflows, test strategy, release processes) across multiple squads, leveraging GitHub, Azure DevOps and other approved tools.

Define and champion responsible AI-assisted engineering practices, including:

  • Standards for using Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and other approved GenAI tools.

  • Expectations for review and validation of AI-generated code.

  • Measurement and optimisation of productivity gains and quality improvements.

  • Mentor and line-manage Senior Full Stack Engineers, supporting their growth in technical leadership, people leadership, and impact across squads.

  • Foster a culture of learning and continuous improvement through communities of practice, architecture forums, and regular knowledge-sharing.

  • Influence and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders (Product, Design, Operations, Risk, Compliance), aligning technical strategies with product and business roadmaps.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Extensive experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale using Spring Boot (Kotlin/Java) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript).

  • Proven track record of simplifying complex architectures and defining cross-team patterns and platforms in a multi-squad environment.

  • Solid experience with containerised workloads and cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or Google Cloud also valuable), including deployment, monitoring, and scaling of microservices and web applications.

  • Deep understanding of secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP), privacy, auditability, and regulatory expectations in financial services or similarly regulated environments.

  • Strong experience with observability, SLOs, incident management, and operational excellence (logging, tracing, metrics, dashboards, on-call practices).

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices, ideally using GiHub actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and automated testing at multiple levels.

  • Experience designing and governing APIs at scale (REST, OpenAPI, API gateways, versioning, backwards compatibility, service contracts).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical programmes or initiatives that span multiple teams and systems, delivering measurable improvements to reliability, performance, or developer productivity.

  • Experience introducing and scaling the use of new tools and standards across organisations, including GenAI technologies (e.g. GitHub Copilot) with appropriate guardrails.

  • Proven people leadership experience: line-managing senior engineers, coaching technical leaders, and building high-performing, inclusive teams.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicate trade-offs clearly, and build consensus.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

jobs.title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
jobs.description:
Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X

TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié
