jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
Account Executive

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Switzerland.

As an Account Executive, you will drive business growth across Europe by selling cutting-edge cloud infrastructure technology to enterprise customers, cloud providers, and fast-growing AI and developer platforms. You will own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to technical evaluations, pilot programs, commercial negotiations, and closing deals. Working closely with the founding team and technical experts, you will help customers understand how next-generation microvirtualization can improve workload isolation, security, and infrastructure efficiency. You will build a qualified pipeline through strategic outbound campaigns, industry networking, and targeted account development. As an early sales hire, you will have a direct influence on the go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and future growth of the commercial organization. This fully remote opportunity combines entrepreneurial ownership, technical learning, and uncapped earning potential in a rapidly evolving AI and cloud infrastructure market.


Accountabilities

  • Build, manage, and grow a European sales pipeline targeting enterprise infrastructure teams, cloud and hosting providers, and high-growth AI and developer technology companies.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying prospects to conducting discovery calls, coordinating technical evaluations, negotiating commercial terms, and securing signed contracts.

  • Develop and execute targeted outbound strategies in collaboration with go-to-market engineers, identifying priority accounts, key decision-makers, and effective messaging to generate qualified opportunities.

  • Lead customer conversations and engage economic buyers early, building relationships with CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security teams, procurement professionals, and other stakeholders involved in complex purchasing decisions.

  • Coordinate product demonstrations, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept or pilot programs alongside founders and field engineers to demonstrate product value and accelerate customer adoption.

  • Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes, showing customers how lightweight microvirtual machines can improve workload isolation, infrastructure utilization, security, and deployment speed.

  • Apply structured qualification methodologies, including MEDDPICC, to assess deal quality, understand decision-making processes, identify risks, and convert successful pilots into long-term production commitments.

  • Develop commercial proposals tailored to customer requirements, including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, dedicated deployments, and bring-your-own-cloud arrangements.

  • Identify opportunities for account expansion by working closely with field engineers and existing customers to understand evolving infrastructure needs and increase adoption.

  • Represent the business at industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and regional meetups, building relationships and converting networking opportunities into qualified pipeline.

  • Collaborate with go-to-market engineers to develop creative prospecting campaigns, improve sales automation, and refine outreach strategies based on market feedback and campaign performance.

  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the sales playbook, sharing insights on customer needs, competitive positioning, objections, and emerging market trends with the founding team and product organization.

  • Maintain accurate records in HubSpot, manage pipeline reporting, and provide reliable forecasts to support business planning and sales execution.

  • Support opportunities across the United States when needed, coordinating with the wider team and accommodating regular calls during European evening hours.

  • Help shape the future sales organization by establishing repeatable processes, sharing best practices, and contributing to the onboarding and development of future sales hires.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 4 years of experience in quota-carrying sales or closing roles, selling technical products to engineering-oriented buyers.

    • Proven experience selling technical solutions, ideally within cloud infrastructure, DevOps, developer tooling, virtualization, serverless computing, or related technology markets.

    • Demonstrated ability to build a sales pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, account research, networking, and targeted engagement strategies.

    • Strong understanding of effective outbound sales practices, with the ability to develop compelling messaging, prioritize accounts, and guide others in improving prospecting performance.

    • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving technical evaluations, proof-of-concept programs, and extended decision-making processes.

    • Ability to engage confidently with technical and economic buyers, including CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security stakeholders, procurement teams, and legal departments.

    • Sufficient technical knowledge to discuss virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and related technologies credibly with engineering teams, combined with the curiosity and motivation to deepen your expertise.

    • Experience converting pilots, proofs of concept, or technical evaluations into signed commercial agreements.

    • Familiarity with usage-based pricing, consumption-based business models, minimum commitments, or other flexible commercial structures.

    • Strong prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to make customers feel comfortable while maintaining a rigorous, analytical approach to sales.

    • Excellent spoken and written English, with additional languages considered an advantage.

    • A high degree of ownership, initiative, adaptability, and learning agility, with the ability to identify problems, take action independently, and continuously improve how work gets done.

    • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to pipeline management, deal qualification, forecasting, and sales performance.

    • Willingness to attend industry events, travel regularly to customers across Europe, and occasionally travel to the United States.

    • Availability to work remotely from a European location within approximately two hours of Central European Time (CET), with flexibility to accommodate regular calls during US business hours.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience using AI tools to research accounts, personalize outreach, generate pipeline, automate sales workflows, and improve deal execution.

      • Familiarity with HubSpot or comparable CRM and sales pipeline management platforms.

      • A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical discipline.

      • Previous experience selling compute infrastructure, serverless platforms, sandboxing technologies, databases, Kubernetes tooling, or related developer infrastructure products.

      • Knowledge of the competitive landscape across cloud infrastructure and developer platforms, including solutions such as Modal, E2B, Daytona, Fly.io, Northflank, Vercel, and Firecracker-based platforms.

      • An established network among European platform engineering teams, cloud providers, systems integrators, or infrastructure decision-makers.

Expansion Intern | Austria or Netherlands

Internship · Full-time · Berlin or Amsterdam

 

Our mission for you

Take trawa beyond borders!

As an Expansion Intern, you'll play a key role in taking trawa into new markets and will experience hands-on what it means to be an operator. You'll work across go-to-market, operations and product, and see up close what it takes to bring a fast-growing energy platform into a new country. We are hiring on a rolling basis, minimum duration is 3 months.

Two markets, one mission:

  • The Netherlands: trawa is preparing its Dutch market entry, and you'll help lay the foundations from day one: understanding the market, positioning trawa, supporting our first sales and commercial activities, and preparing everything for launch.

We staff you on the market where your profile and our needs fit best. Either way, you'll build something that truly matters.

 
 

What you'll do, whichever market you work on:

  • Supercharge local go-to-market: You research competitors, help define how trawa wins in your market and support early customer acquisition. Your work directly drives our local growth.

  • Turn regulation into a competitive edge: Energy markets change constantly. You track legal and regulatory updates, work out what they mean for trawa and help us adapt faster than anyone else.

  • Build local operations: You support product rollouts, from contract frameworks to processes, and help adapt what works at our Berlin HQ to the local market.

  • Shape the product for new markets: You bring local customer and market insights into our product team and help make sure trawa fits the needs of businesses in your country.

  • Become the market expert: You run ad-hoc analyses, build market overviews and quickly become the go-to person for everything specific to your country.

  • Collaborate with leadership: You work closely with our expansion leads and senior leadership. You take ownership of your own initiatives and see them through from idea to execution.

  • You are a true team player: You understand that humility and performance go hand in hand, and that what counts is the overall success of the team.

 

Who we are looking for

Standout candidates who want to grow with us:

  • Advanced Bachelor's student, in your gap year, Master's student, or recent graduate with outstanding academic achievements.

  • You have a strong track record. Analytical skills, an entrepreneurial mindset and a high degree of independence set you apart.

  • You’re highly motivated, hands-on, and eager to take real responsibility.

  • You have first practical experience in a dynamic startup, top-tier strategy consultancy or investment banking.

Market-specific requirements:

Why us?

  • Your impact: Your work has a direct influence on how trawa grows across Europe, and you get to help shape a new market from the ground up.

  • Flexible working: We foster a vibrant company culture where we love to work together, and home office is also an option. With flexible working hours and 30 vacation days, we support your work-life balance.

jobs.title: Product Design Manager
jobs.description:
Product Design Manager

MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We're growing fast and hiring the Design leadership to match.

Our users are maintenance technicians, reliability engineers, and operations managers working on factory floors, in processing plants, and across distributed facilities. We're looking for a Product Design Manager to lead a team of product designers who make these complex, high-stakes workflows simple, intuitive, and increasingly AI-powered. You'll set creative direction across your team's product areas, grow designers at different stages of their careers, and partner deeply with Product and Engineering to ensure design is shaping outcomes, not just shipping screens. In this role, you'll be close to the work, close to the people, and accountable for both.

What You'll Do

  • Own design quality across your team's product areas for web and mobile. Guide designers through ambiguity, review work with a sharp eye, and ensure what ships is grounded in real user needs and built to a high standard.

  • Lead and grow a team of 4-6 product designers. Run 1:1s, drive career growth, deliver clear feedback, and build a team culture where people do their best work. You'll be responsible for hiring, performance, and developing the next generation of design talent at MaintainX.

  • Translate product strategy into focused design execution. Help your team understand not just what they're building, but why it matters. Set a clear, directional vision for your team's focus, rooted in customer understanding and business context.

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineering leads. Align on priorities, unblock delivery, and advocate for design quality and user needs in every conversation.

  • Raise the craft bar. Contribute to design critiques, invest in our design system, and ensure consistency and coherence across the experiences your team touches.

  • Lead your team in adopting AI tools and practices to accelerate design work and push the quality and speed of your team's output.

About You

  • 6+ years of product design experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise platforms. You've shipped complex, multi-surface work and you know what good looks like because you've done it yourself.

  • 1–3 years of experience managing product designers. Running 1:1s, giving feedback that changes the work, navigating performance conversations, and helping people grow. You chose management because you're energized by making others better.

  • Strong product thinking and craft judgment. You understand customer problems, business tradeoffs, and how to connect design work to strategy. You don't simplify by removing; you simplify by clarifying.

  • You build trust through how you show up. Consistent, direct, and accountable. You create clarity for your team, resolve friction with partners early, and lead with enough confidence to make decisions and enough humility to change your mind.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect (EST or PST hours)
jobs.description:
Solutions Architect (EST or PST hours)

Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: This individual must be based in either Eastern or Pacific Time in the US. or willing to work during these time zone work hours

Opportunity
Deepgram is seeking a talented, support-focused Solutions Architect (Applied Engineer) to join our Applied Engineering (AppEng) team. In this role, you will directly engage with customers to solve complex technical challenges while simultaneously building scalable solutions that enhance our support infrastructure. You'll own complete customer engagements in a post-sales capacity, and occasionally assist with pre-sales and implementation projects as needed. Your strong engineering background will enable you to resolve sophisticated technical issues, create repeatable solutions, and develop automation that allows the broader AppEng team to focus on high-impact pre-sales activities. This position offers an excellent path to grow into broader implementation and pre-sales roles while making an immediate impact on our customer support experience. As a key member of the Applied Engineering team, you'll influence our customer support strategy, and play a crucial role in ensuring our customers receive exceptional technical assistance throughout their journey with Deepgram.

About Applied Engineering at Deepgram
The Applied Engineering (AppEng) team at Deepgram combines the functions that other companies might separate into Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Implementation, and Technical Support. We serve as the technical interface between Deepgram and our customers throughout their entire journey, from initial discovery and proof-of-concept, through implementation and onboarding, to ongoing technical support. We work closely with our Customer Success and Developer Experience (DX) teams to ensure a positive, growth-focused experience for our customers. This unified approach allows us to provide comprehensive technical guidance and build deeper relationships with our customers. As a support-focused Applied Engineer, you'll be primarily concerned with elevating our technical support capabilities while having opportunities to contribute to the broader Applied Engineering mission in pre-sales, implementation, and more.

What you'll do

  • Own the technical design and delivery of customer implementations and migrations, from kickoff through production cutover

  • Lead deployment scaling work, including capacity planning, rollout sequencing, and verification methodology

  • Design solutions that fit each customer's existing stack, constraints, and operational shape

  • Partner with Customer Success and Account Executives on customer-side change management, including readiness, stakeholder alignment, and rollout communication

  • Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, and deployment playbooks that the broader AppEng team and customers can reuse

  • Create automation and self-service tooling that compresses time-to-value for repeatable implementation work

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and influence the roadmap based on patterns observed in active deployments

  • Provide support for the most complex post-onboarding cases when escalation crosses into Solutions Architect territory

  • Occasionally support pre-sales technical work, including discovery, scoping, and proof-of-concept design

Time allocation

  • 50% — Customer implementation and scaling engagements

  • 20% — Building reusable patterns, reference architectures, and automation

  • 15% — Pre-sales technical support, including discovery, demos, and proof-of-concepts

  • 10% — Documentation and knowledge sharing

  • 5% — Complex post-onboarding escalations and collaboration with Technical Support Engineers

Your first 90 days

  • First 30 days — Complete comprehensive onboarding to understand Deepgram's technology, products, and the patterns we use for implementations. Gain proficiency with our core APIs and documentation. Shadow active implementation engagements to build familiarity with how the AppEng team operates during customer change phases.

  • 60 days — Begin owning customer implementation engagements end-to-end, leading technical design and partnering with Customer Success on rollout. Start contributing to reusable implementation patterns and reference architectures.

  • 90 days — Own the technical delivery of multiple concurrent customer implementations. Develop and deliver scalable solutions for repeatable customer change patterns. Begin contributing to the Applied Engineering team's implementation methodology and mentoring newer team members.

You'll love this role if you...

  • Enjoy seeing customer technical environments transformed through careful implementation work

  • Are passionate about reducing the time it takes any customer to reach production value with Deepgram

  • Find satisfaction in designing patterns that scale beyond a single customer engagement

  • Have a talent for identifying recurring needs across customers and translating them into reusable artifacts

  • Are energized by deploying cutting-edge Voice AI in production environments with real customers

  • See implementation work as a strategic function that drives customer growth and retention

It's important to us that you have

  • 3+ years of experience implementing or deploying technical solutions for enterprise customers, ideally in customer-facing technical roles

  • Strong software engineering background with professional development experience in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Rust, C / C++, or similar languages

  • Experience leading technical delivery of production deployments, from design through cutover

  • Proven ability to scope complex technical work and sequence it for successful delivery

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering and business stakeholders alike

It would be great if you had

  • Experience with speech recognition, natural language processing, AI Voice agents, or related AI technologies

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with API-first products and developer tools

  • Background in change-management or implementation methodology

  • Experience producing reference architectures, deployment playbooks, or implementation templates

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

Full-Time USA

jobs.title: Director, Global Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Director, Global Solutions Engineering

Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

We're hiring a Director of Global Solutions Engineering to lead the technical engine behind our revenue organization. As a cybersecurity company, our technical credibility is central to how we win and keep customers — and this leader owns it across the customer journey. You'll run a global, two-part function as a manager of managers: Sales Engineers who drive the technical win in new business (pre-sales), and Solutions Consultants who serve as the technical escalation path for our post-sales teams. You'll report directly to the CRO.

This is a builder's role for a leader who is equally comfortable in a strategy conversation with the executive team, in a technical deep-dive with an engineer, and jumping into a live customer call to lead it when it counts. Details of the remit are below.

What will you do?

  • Lead a global, multi-layered team. Manage and develop distributed managers and their teams of Sales Engineers and Solutions Consultants across regions. Hire, coach, and retain top technical talent; set clear career paths; and build a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, and customer obsession.

  • Own the technical win in pre-sales. Lead the Sales Engineering team to drive pipeline conversion through world-class demos, proofs of concept, technical discovery, and value engineering — consistently earning the technical decision.

  • Own the post-sales technical escalation path. Lead the Solutions Consultants team as the technical escalation path for CSMs and the driver of technical cross-sell across our product suite. (Note: with a dedicated Professional Services team being stood up, Solutions Consultants are not expected to own customer onboarding today — though this scope may evolve.)

  • Stay hands-on when it counts. Be willing and able to personally jump into a high-stakes customer call and lead it — you set the technical bar by example, not just from the org chart.

  • Elevate RFPs and security assessments. Build a scalable, high-quality function for RFPs, security questionnaires, and technical/security assessments — improving accuracy, consistency, and turnaround, and building reusable content that raises win rates.

  • Enable and scale the channel. Technically enable partners — training, certification, demo readiness, and deal support — so they can independently represent and implement our product.

  • Partner with Enablement. Work with Sales Enablement to design and deliver technical training, certification, demo standards, and competitive playbooks that keep the team and the wider revenue org sharp.

  • Be the voice of the customer to Product. Capture field and technical feedback and channel it to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.

  • Operate as a revenue leader. Contribute to forecasting, capacity planning, and go-to-market strategy with the CRO and revenue leadership team, and define the metrics and processes that make the function measurable and scalable.

What will you bring?

  • We care far more about your track record than your tenure. The bar is a leader who has built and run a world-class technical team serving technical customers with a technical product.

    • A demonstrated track record of building and leading a world-class Solutions/Sales Engineering team — you've raised the technical bar of an organization, not just managed headcount.

    • Experience selling and supporting a genuinely technical product to technical buyers and evaluators (engineers, security teams, architects). Cybersecurity or security/GRC experience is strongly preferred; adjacent deeply-technical domains considered.

    • Proven experience as a manager of managers leading distributed or global teams across multiple time zones.

    • Ownership of the technical experience across the customer journey — from the technical win in new business through post-sales technical support and cross-sell.

    • A hands-on disposition — you're credible and willing in the room, able to step into and lead a high-stakes customer call yourself.

    • A track record of building or scaling RFP / security assessment functions and lifting win rates through repeatable process and reusable content.

    • Experience technically enabling channel / partner ecosystems so partners can represent and implement the product independently.

    • A strong partnership orientation — you've worked shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Enablement.

    • Excellent executive communication skills; equally credible with C-level buyers and hands-on technical evaluators.

    • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, remote-first environment.

What's in it for you?

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work

  • Health Insurance: Access to comprehensive coverage.

  • Stock Options: Share in UpGuard's growth and long-term success.

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, LA, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks. Also, please note that at this time, we cannot support candidates requiring visa sponsorship or relocation.

We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. jobs.title: Chief of Staff / Future Founder (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Chief of Staff / Future Founder (m/w/d)

Du suchst keinen klassischen Job. Du suchst die maximale Herausforderung und ein Umfeld, das so ambitioniert ist wie Du.

Die WTE Group baut und skaliert Unternehmen gegen den Fachkräftemangel. Mit WTE Charkos bringen wir Pflegefachkräfte aus Indien nach Deutschland, mit B2-Deutsch vor dem ersten Gespräch und einem eigenen Ausbildungszentrum in Mysore. Charkos wächst gegen den Markttrend. Mit WTE Companion entwickeln wir die App, die internationalen Fachkräften und Studenten das Ankommen in Deutschland abnimmt, von der Wohnung bis zum Bankkonto. Und mit unserem eigenen Software- und KI-Team bauen wir gerade ein Venture Studio auf, das neue KI-Produkte für die Branchen entwickelt, die wir aus dem Tagesgeschäft kennen.

Dafür suchen wir die rechte Hand der beiden Gründer. Zunächst heißt das: Du arbeitest direkt mit uns, nimmst uns die Themen ab, die zwischen Strategie und Tagesgeschäft liegen, und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheidungen fallen und umgesetzt werden. Wer das zwei bis drei Jahre auf Top-Niveau macht, hat alles gelernt, um danach selbst ein Venture der Gruppe zu führen.

Was Du bei uns machst

  • Rechte Hand der Gründer: Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, hältst die Fäden zwischen Hamburg, Mysore und unseren Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt, was die Geschäftsführung angestoßen hat.

  • Sonderprojekte: Finanzierung, Partnerverhandlungen mit Banken und Versicherern, Ausschreibungen, Aufbau neuer Teams und Standorte. Du übernimmst, was gerade am wichtigsten ist, und bringst es zu Ende.

  • Operative Exzellenz: Du übersetzt Strategie in Routinen, Zahlen und Prozesse, damit die Gruppe mit jedem neuen Venture stabiler wird statt chaotischer.

  • Business Development: Du erkennst Wachstumschancen, baust strategische Partnerschaften auf und treibst Deals eigenständig bis zur Unterschrift.

  • Venture Building: Du begleitest neue Produkte und Ventures aus dem Studio vom ersten Businessplan bis zur Marktreife, egal ob KI-Software oder Dienstleistung.

  • Sparringspartner: Du forderst die Gründer heraus, lieferst Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf den Punkt und filterst, was wirklich auf den Tisch der Geschäftsführung gehört.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Exzellente Ausbildung: Studium mit herausragenden Ergebnissen, gern an einer der führenden Hochschulen.

  • Nachgewiesene Spitzenleistung: Du hast schon einmal bewiesen, dass Du zu den Besten gehörst. Das muss kein wirtschaftlicher Hintergrund sein: Spitzensport, Musik, eine eigene Gründung oder ein anderes Feld mit höchstem Leistungsanspruch zählen genauso.

  • Intelligenz und Hunger: Brillante Auffassungsgabe, unternehmerisches Denken und der feste Wille, in Zukunft selbst zu gründen.

Pricing/ Commercial Strategy Manager (w/m/d)

Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen.

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Als Pricing/ Commercial Strategy Manager bist du für die Preis- und Werbestrategie deiner Produktfamilien über nationale und internationale Marken hinweg verantwortlich. Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Marketing und weiteren Teams entwickelst du E-Commerce-Strategien, die Umsätze, Wachstum und Marktanteile steigern. Du analysierst Wettbewerber sowie Markttrends und optimierst die Positionierung von Produkten, Preisen und Angeboten.

Du arbeitest an strategisch wichtigen Marken und Produktlinien mit hoher Sichtbarkeit im Management sowie ehrgeizigen Wachstumszielen und treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kommerz- und Preisstrategie voran.

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Online Pricing- und Promotion-Strategien zur Steigerung von Umsatz, Profitabilität, Neukundengewinnung und Marktanteilen.

  • Planung, Umsetzung und Erfolgsmessung von Pricing- und Promotion-Kampagnen über verschiedene Kanäle.
  • Entwicklung und Steuerung von Pricing-Roadmaps im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen.
  • Analyse relevanter Commercial Performance-Kennzahlen und Ableitung von Maßnahmen bei Abweichungen.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Marketing, Sales und weiteren Teams.
  • Entwicklung zielgruppenspezifischer Angebote und Kommunikation sowie Beobachtung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen.

Qualifikationen

  • Bachelorabschluss in BWL, VWL, Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Pricing, Marketing oder Product Management, idealerweise im Online-, IT-/Technologieumfeld.
  • Sehr gute analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen Daten.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Themen parallel zu steuern.
  • Fließende Englisch- sowie und Deutschkenntnisse, Französisch oder Spanisch sind ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung und starkes Interesse an der Nutzung von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, z. B. der Einsatz von Generativer KI zur Synthese von Marktanalysen und für die Datenmodellierung.
  • Neugierige, offene und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit Interesse an einem dynamischen Umfeld.

  • Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

Conseiller de Vente - La Samaritaine (H/F)

Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Conseiller(e) de vente (H/F) en CDI, pour rejoindre notre équipe de la Samaritaine. Ce poste est basé à La Samaritaine à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) au Directeur de l’Appartement, vos principales responsabilités seront : 

Délivrer une expérience client singulière : 

  • Faire du client la priorité de l’appartement pour garantir un service client optimal ;
  • Incarner l’esprit et le style Sézane par une présentation impeccable (respect du grooming) ;
  • Accueillir vos clients avec générosité et empathie afin de leur offrir la meilleure expérience possible ;
  • Considérer la personnalité de vos Clients afin d'identifier ses désirs ;
  • Faire découvrir la Marque et nos différents univers/ produits ;
  • Etre ambassadeur de l'omnicanalité de la Marque (appartement et web) ;
  • Faire preuve de curiosité et développer une connaissance approfondie de la Marque et des produits ;
  • Être force de proposition d’actions spécifiques pour rendre l’expérience client mémorable et unique ;
  • Traiter les réclamations et insatisfactions clients pour satisfaire et fidéliser nos clients ;
  • Connaître notre politique RSE pour répondre aux clients.

Garantir l’image de Marque : 

  • Connaître les règles de bases du merchandising Sézane ;
  • Vérifier l’étiquetage des produits sur le floor ;
  • Participer à l’implantation du merchandising et veiller à son suivi ;
  • Offrir aux clients une expérience shopping passionnante et inspirante ;
  • Suivre et maintenir le niveau commercial du point de vente ;
  • Avoir une culture mode pour être force de propositions.

Veiller au bon déroulement des Opérations : 

  • Appliquer les politiques, Standards et procédures Sézane ;
  • Encaisser et respecter les procédures liées aux opérations ;
  • Effectuer les process de traitements spécifiques (retours, échanges, réservations) ;
  • Participer à la définition des effectifs nécessaires pour répondre aux attentes clients ;
  • Garantir la bonne gestion des stocks.

Avoir un esprit d’équipe :

  • Etre Team-player, participer à toutes les tâches annexes ;
  • Participer à la création d’un environnement positif et harmonieux pour créer une synergie de groupe ;
  • Relayer les engagements de la marque.

Requirements

  • Vous avez une première expérience réussie en prêt à porter, en hôtellerie, en restauration, en vente, en animation… ou pas encore, mais êtes animé par le relationnel client?
  • Vous avez le sens du service, une excellente présentation et une forte sensibilité mode ;
  • Vous avez l’esprit d’équipe, l’envie de partager et développer vos compétences dans un environnement agile et galvanisant ;
  •  Vous n’aimez pas vous ennuyer car vous débordez d’énergie?

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

Responsable commercial régional

Description de l'équipe

SumUp accélère le déploiement de ses équipes de vente terrain en France, et ce poste à responsabilité façonnera cette croissance à Toulouse, en apportant nos outils de paiement et de gestion aux petites entreprises de la région. C'est l'occasion de construire une région depuis ses fondations, avec une évolution possible vers un poste de Territory Manager à mesure que l'équipe et l'activité se développent, en rapportant au Head of Region France.

Vos missions

  • Diriger et développer une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en construisant les compétences et la culture nécessaires pour s'imposer sur le marché

  • Fixer le niveau d'exigence en matière de performance commerciale, en ancrant une culture de coaching et de responsabilisation au sein de l'équipe terrain

  • Façonner les outils de vente, du support de présentation aux contenus d'accompagnement, pour permettre à l'équipe de rivaliser et de gagner

  • Maintenir une présence forte sur le terrain, réaliser des audits auprès des marchands et transformer la connaissance du marché en actions concrètes

  • Définir la stratégie concurrentielle de la région et tenir les parties prenantes seniors informées de l'avancement

Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si…

  • Expérience avérée dans la direction et le développement d'équipes commerciales, incluant le coaching de consultants indépendants vers une performance durable

  • Expérience dans la construction d'une région ou d'un territoire commercial dès ses débuts, avec la structure nécessaire pour le faire évoluer

  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, avec une crédibilité reconnue pour évoluer dans des environnements multiculturels et face à des parties prenantes variées

  • Prise de décision stratégique et orientée données, avec la capacité à diriger dans l'incertitude d'un marché en forte croissance

Pourquoi rejoindre SumUp

🌎 Opportunité de travailler avec des SumUppers du monde entier sur des produits fintech à grande échelle utilisés par des millions d'entreprises, dans le cadre d'un poste de terrain couvrant la région de Toulouse. Ce poste implique des déplacements réguliers pour accompagner votre équipe sur le territoire 🌈 Engagement envers la diversité et l'inclusion : faites partie d'un environnement de travail qui valorise et promeut la diversité, favorisant un cadre inclusif où les perspectives de chacun sont respectées et accueillies 🚀 Adhésion à notre programme d'options d'achat d'actions virtuelles (VSOP) : vous détiendrez une participation dans le succès futur de SumUp 📚 Un budget annuel dédié de 2000 € pour votre développement personnel, utilisable pour assister à des conférences et/ou faire progresser votre carrière grâce à une formation complémentaire 💼 Sécurité financière : des cotisations de retraite d'entreprise qui soutiennent votre avenir à long terme 🏥 Accompagnement santé : nous prenons en charge 50 % du coût mensuel de votre assurance santé (Mutuelle et Prévoyance) 🚌 Avantages supplémentaires : nous proposons des titres restaurant (Swile) et prenons en charge vos frais de transport 🏖 Congés généreux : profitez de 25 jours de congés payés, ainsi que des jours fériés et des jours de congés spéciaux 🎉 Petits déjeuners réguliers, événements d'équipe, fêtes de bureau et activités sportives 🌴 Break4me : un mois sabbatique après 3 ans d'ancienneté 🔗 Prime de cooptation : bénéficiez de récompenses supplémentaires en recommandant des talents pour rejoindre l'équipe SumUp

À propos de SumUp

Soyez acteur d'un changement qui compte vraiment.

Chez SumUp, notre mission est d'accompagner les petites entreprises du monde entier en leur proposant des outils simples et accessibles qui leur permettent de prospérer. Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 millions d'entreprises dans 39 marchés font confiance à SumUp comme partenaire financier pour gérer leurs paiements, leurs finances et leurs relations clients.

Notre engagement envers les petites entreprises se reflète dans notre équipe diversifiée de plus de 4 000 SumUppers originaires de plus de 90 nationalités, unis par une collaboration mondiale et un esprit innovant. Nos valeurs fondamentales constituent le socle de notre identité et de nos convictions, façonnant notre culture de travail et portant notre réussite. Nous cultivons l'inclusion et une culture d'apprentissage continu, en offrant un espace sûr pour l'épanouissement personnel et professionnel. Nos différences font notre unicité et notre force, à mesure que nous œuvrons à créer un environnement où chacun se sent à sa place et soutenu, quelle que soit son identité.

SumUp est fier d'être un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, recherchant et accueillant activement la diversité au sein de ses équipes. Nous ne fondons nos décisions de recrutement ou d'emploi sur aucun critère de race, de couleur, de religion ou de conviction religieuse, d'origine ethnique ou nationale, de nationalité, de sexe, d'identité de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, de handicap, d'âge, ou de tout autre critère protégé par la loi applicable ou interdit par la politique de l'entreprise. Notre engagement va au delà du recrutement pour créer un lieu de travail sûr et respectueux, où toute forme de harcèlement est strictement interdite. Découvrez-en davantage sur notre culture et nos opportunités sur notre site carrières, et suivez notre actualité sur LinkedIn, Instagram et TikTok.

Enterprise Account Executive

Do you get energy from winning new customers? Do you know how to build a pipeline from scratch, engage senior decision-makers and turn complex business challenges into successful deals?

At Yenlo, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just manage them.

This is a true hunting role, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on Yenlo's growth. We have built a strong international business in Integration, API Management, Identity & Access Management and Managed Services. Now we are expanding into Data, AI, Automation and Control. We have the technology expertise, strong partnerships and delivery capabilities. What we need is someone who can bring us to the right table, create demand and win new business.

About Yenlo

Yenlo has helped organisations connect their business-critical systems and processes for more than 17 years. We do this with around 100 colleagues from over 18 nationalities, with offices in the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Sri Lanka, the United States and Canada. We have been a WSO2 Platinum Partner since 2008 and a Boomi partner since 2015, and our customers include Boeing, Hard Rock Café and several ministries and universities. Now we are building on our integration expertise with Data, AI and Automation, so customers can bring their technology into production securely and reliably. For that, we are looking for someone who opens new markets.

What will you do?

As Enterprise Account Executive, your primary mission is to win new customers and build profitable, long-term business relationships.

You will focus on mid-market and enterprise organisations across the Benelux and DACH regions, particularly those facing complex challenges around applications, integration, data, cloud transformation and AI.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Win new logos and build your own pipeline. Identify target accounts, open doors and generate business through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and strategic partnerships.

  • Engage senior decision-makers and sell business value. Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs and other business and technology leaders, and translate their challenges into opportunities around Integration, Data, AI, Automation and Control.

  • Own the sales cycle. Lead opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, negotiation and closing, together with our solution architects, consultants and product specialists.

  • Help shape our go-to-market. Bring customer insights and market feedback into Yenlo to help us improve our propositions and commercial approach.

  • Deliver results. Take ownership of your pipeline, forecasts, new-business targets and the profitability of the deals you win.

You will have access to existing customer references, partner relationships and marketing support. But this is not a role where you inherit a ready-to-close pipeline or rely on an SDR team to fill your calendar. We expect you to create opportunities yourself and have the commercial drive to turn them into business.

What can you expect from Yenlo?

At Yenlo, you will join an international technology company with around 100 colleagues, strong technical expertise and ambitious plans for the future.

We offer:

  • Real ownership. A new-business role with the freedom to develop opportunities and make a visible commercial impact.

  • Attractive earning potential. A competitive fixed salary and a substantial performance-based bonus, with uncapped upside for overachievement.

  • A strong technology portfolio. Established capabilities in Integration, API Management, IAM and Managed Services, complemented by growing propositions in Data, AI and Control.

  • Access to specialists. Experienced solution architects, consultants and product teams to support discovery, demonstrations, assessments and proposals.

  • An international ecosystem. Partnerships with leading technology providers, including Boomi and WSO2, alongside Yenlo's own Connext platform.

  • Room to build. The opportunity to contribute to our evolving commercial approach, propositions and go-to-market strategy.

  • Professional benefits. Pension arrangements, holiday allowance, a lease car or mobility allowance, laptop and phone.

  • A realistic start. An appropriate ramp-up period, recognising that enterprise sales cycles take time and building a pipeline starts from day one.

You will work closely with our sales leadership and wider commercial organisation. We believe in face-to-face collaboration, both with customers and colleagues, and expect you to spend time at our Schiphol-Rijk office on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays.


We are looking for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial sales professional with a proven track record in complex B2B technology sales.

You know how to build relationships, navigate enterprise organisations and close significant deals.

What you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of generating your own pipeline and personally closing new enterprise customers.

  • Experience selling complex IT services, software, cloud, integration or other enterprise technology solutions.

  • Experience managing six-figure deals and longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Strong outbound prospecting, consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.

  • The ability to engage credibly with senior business and technology decision-makers.

  • Enough technical understanding to discuss Integration, APIs, Data and AI, while focusing on business outcomes rather than technical features.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the resilience to succeed without a fully established sales playbook.

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with technical and commercial colleagues.

  • Professional proficiency in Dutch and English.

Experience with platforms such as Boomi, WSO2, MuleSoft, AWS, Azure or related enterprise technologies is an advantage, but not a requirement. An existing network in the Benelux or DACH enterprise market would be a strong plus. We care more about what you have personally achieved than the number of years on your CV or the technology companies you have worked for.

Ready to make an impact?

If you enjoy opening doors, creating opportunities and winning complex enterprise deals, we would love to meet you.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Education
jobs.description:
Head of Customer Education

Head of Customer Education

Hi, I'm Casey, and I lead Customer Success Management and Customer Education at Ashby. I'm excited to be hiring our Head of Education at Ashby — a role that will drive forward our Recruiting Operations Consulting, Academy, and Product Enablement functions. You'll inherit a team of strong, motivated people and take on the work of further unifying them under a coherent educational strategy: one that serves customers directly through consulting engagements and Academy programs, and serves Ashby internally through how we train and enable our GTM teams to teach, demo, and demonstrate the value of Ashby.

About This Role

The goal of our Education team is to act as a CSM for every customer and GTM employee. We are principled in how we operate and create content and experiences that are truly useful to our audience. Our Academy consists of public-facing content and digital programs that aim to meet customers where they are — whether that's a Recruiting Manager just getting started with Ashby or a Head of Talent looking to improve Quality of Hire. Our RecOps Consulting team brings deep operational expertise to customers who need more than product guidance, through both 1:1 and scaled experiences. And our Product Enablement function exists to close the gap between what the product can do and what CS and sales teams can confidently apply in practice.

As Head of Education, you'll manage across all three of these functions and own the operating model that ties them together. At the start, this will mean being close to the work — managing ICs alongside early leaders and building out the leadership layer over time as the organization scales.

Day-to-day, this looks like:

  • RecOps Consulting

    • Overseeing RecOps Consulting, ensuring 1:1 customer engagements are driving real value, and that insights from direct consulting work find their way into Academy content rather than staying locked in individual engagements.

    • Partnering with Professional Services on scoping and delivering paid RecOps engagements — including how packages are structured, where the line sits between complimentary and paid work, and how the consulting model evolves by segment.

  • Academy

    • Partnering with the Manager of Academy on content strategy — what gets built, how it's organized, and how the library evolves as the product and customer base grow.

    • Building out new Academy programs, including a product certification path, centralizing the webinar function under CE, and launching a Digital Programs capability that brings education directly to customers through in-app and email experiences.

  • Product Enablement

    • Building out Product Enablement as a distinct function — translating the last 20% of product context for CSMs and AEs, addressing the continuous shipping problem for our field teams, and designing a new hire onboarding experience that's more durable than what we have today.

  • Team

    • Building the operating infrastructure that lets all three functions scale: intake processes, engagement frameworks, capacity planning, and the connective tissue that keeps the functions working together rather than in parallel.

    • While you'll start by managing a mix of Managers and ICs across Consulting and Academy, you’ll be responsible for identifying where additional layers are needed to effectively scale the org — either by developing from within or hiring externally.

    • Representing CE externally through webinars, industry events, and customer sessions — and synthesizing what you hear back into credible, specific product feedback.

There isn't one standard background that defines success in this role. If your experience includes building and scaling Recruiting Operations, Customer Success, or Customer Education functions, we'd encourage you to apply.

You Could Be a Great Fit If

  • You think from first principles about education. You're skeptical of "best practices" as a starting point and more interested in what actually serves the specific audience in front of you — whether that's a recruiter trying to figure out offer approvals or a CSM trying to explain a product release.

  • You're a strong leader of leaders. You develop the people beneath you deliberately, hold a high bar without micromanaging, and create an environment where your team does their best work.

  • You think in operating models. You can look at three distinct functions and figure out what they need to share, where they need to stay separate, and how to build systems without over-engineering.

  • You're energized by being close to the work. While you'll eventually have a leadership team in place, you'll start by directly managing our RecOps Consultants and Academy team.

  • You build strong cross-functional relationships. You'll need to partner closely with leadership counterparts across CS, Sales, Product, and Marketing — and the ability to show up as a credible, collaborative peer in those conversations is as important as what you build within CE.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by building. This is not a standard Education role and the team is still early — we need someone who can figure out how we scale and help build toward that.

  • You communicate with clarity and operate well in a writing-heavy culture. At Ashby, proposals, frameworks, and documentation are how decisions get made and work moves forward.

  • You think carefully about the full customer spectrum — from the team of one setting up their first ATS to the enterprise org navigating complex integrations — and can build programs that serve both without defaulting to just one end.

  • You're comfortable hopping into new tools and figuring them out. You won't necessarily be building, but you'll engage directly enough to support your team — whether that's understanding how an in-product journey gets configured or evaluating a new LMS feature.

  • You have a perspective on how consulting fits into an education strategy — where 1:1 expertise should scale into content, where it shouldn't, and how the two motions reinforce each other.

You Might Not Be a Great Fit If

  • You prefer to set strategy and hand it off. This role requires staying close enough to the work to build the systems and infrastructure that support it — not just directing others toward a vision and stepping back.

  • You're not comfortable in front of customers. There will be moments where you're supporting a RecOps Consulting engagement in a leadership capacity, or take the stage during an Ashby-hosted event.

  • You don't enjoy reviewing content. You'll be the final bar for what the team publishes and the experiences they create, and that means staying close enough to the work to know when something isn't ready.

  • You rely on industry playbooks to tell you what an education function should look like. We have strong opinions about what effective CE should be, and we're looking for someone who is principled and will build from first principles.

  • You find it hard to thrive when the scope is shifting. This function is constantly evolving as business needs shift, and you'll need to be genuinely energized by that rather than stabilized by a fixed remit.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview with Global Head of Customer Success — 45 minutes

  • Presentation with CE team leads and cross-functional partners — 60 minutes

  • Final Panel:

    • VP of CS — 30 minutes

    • CEO Interview — 30 minutes

    • Closing Questions — 15 minutes

Benefits

  • Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby — do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it!

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us, and an automatic 401k match.

jobs.title: B2B Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
B2B Marketing Manager (m/w/d)

Jobbeschreibung

bonial ist Teil der Axel Springer SE und verändert als führender „Drive-to-Store“-Partner in Deutschland und Frankreich die Einzelhandelslandschaft. Über unsere Plattformen „“ und „“ in Deutschland sowie „“ in Frankreich verbinden wir Millionen von Nutzer:innen mit ihren Lieblingsgeschäften und -marken – und erzielen so jeden Tag spürbare Wirkung.

Wir befinden uns mitten in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase, skalieren rasant und verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen den Einzelhandel entdecken. Bei bonial arbeiten wir in einem leistungsorientierten, dynamischen Umfeld, das von motivierten, ergebnisorientierten Persönlichkeiten geprägt ist, die mit Leidenschaft etwas bewegen wollen. Wenn Du Teil eines dynamischen Teams werden möchtest, das die Zukunft des Einzelhandels mitgestaltet, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Als

B2B Marketing Manager (m/w/d) bei bonial bist Du verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Marketingstrategien, die sich an unsere Geschäftskund:innen richten – von großen Handelsketten bis hin zu innovativen Markenpartnern. Du positionierst bonial als Vordenker im Bereich Retail Media und stärkst unsere Sichtbarkeit in relevanten Kanälen.

Deine Aufgaben:

Strategieentwicklung:

  • Entwicklung von Marketingstrategien zur Ansprache von Geschäftskund:innen
  • Positionierung der Marke bonial im B2B-Markt

Content-Marketing:

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der B2B-Content-Strategie entlang relevanter Zielgruppen, Themenfelder und Unternehmensziele
  • Leitung von Content-Initiativen einschließlich der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der bonial-Website
  • Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung des bonial B2B-Newsletters, inklusive Themenplanung, visueller Gestaltung und Versand
  • Crossmediale Verlängerung von Inhalten über Website, Newsletter, LinkedIn und weitere relevante B2B-Kanäle
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit PR, Sales, Marketing, Product und weiteren Fachbereichen zur Entwicklung relevanter Inhalte
  • Analyse relevanter Content-KPIs und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Formaten und Themen
  • Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Markenkommunikation und Corporate Identity über alle relevanten Content-Touchpoints

Kampagnenmanagement:

  • Einsatz von Performance-Marketing-Tools (z. B. LinkedIn Ads), um die Kampagneneffektivität zu steigern
  • Buchung von Anzeigen in relevanten digitalen Fachmagazinen (z. B. Horizont, Lebensmittelzeitung)

Messen & Eventmanagement:

  • Organisation der bonial-Präsenz auf Messen, Konferenzen und Networking-Events (z. B. Standaufbau, Speaker Slots, Sponsoring-Pakete)
  • Planung inkl. Einladungsmanagement von B2B-Events, die von bonial veranstaltet werden

Markt- & Wettbewerbsanalyse:

  • Beobachtung von Markttrends und Aktivitäten von Wettbewerbern
  • Analyse von Erkenntnissen und Ableitung strategischer Empfehlungen

Leadgenerierung & Qualifizierung:

  • Planung und Durchführung von Multichannel-Leadgenerierungskampagnen (z. B. über LinkedIn, E-Mail-Marketing, Webinare)
  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Sales-Team zur Qualifizierung von Leads und Unterstützung beim Aufbau der Sales-Pipeline

Reporting & KPIs:

  • Festlegung und Monitoring relevanter KPIs zur Messung der Marketingeffektivität
  • Durchführung regelmäßiger Performance-Analysen und Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil:

  • Abschluss in Marketing, Kommunikation, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise in einem technologiegetriebenen oder digitalen Umfeld
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Marketing-Technologien (z. B. HubSpot, WordPress, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager)
  • Ausgezeichnete Projektmanagementfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu steuern
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Events und Fachmessen
  • Gutes Gespür für relevante Inhalte und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (Niveau C1–C2) und Englisch
  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
  • Ausgeprägter Teamgeist, kooperative Denkweise und Begeisterung für funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

Was wir Dir bieten können:

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt.

Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen.
Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen.

Diversität - Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitsplatz für Chancengleichheit zu sein, an dem wir es jeder Person ermöglichen möchten, ihr wahres selbst zu zeigen. Wir setzten uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, und dafür, ein Safe Space zu sein unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Gender, Geschlechtsidentität oder Geschlechtsausdruck.

Wohlbefinden - Für uns ist mentale Gesundheit genauso wichtig wie Fitness. Deshalb bieten wir Dir einen kostenlosen Zugang zu nilo.health, einer App für mentale Gesundheit, an. Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club.

Nachhaltigkeit - Dir liegt das Thema Nachhaltigkeit am Herzen? Uns auch! Zusammen mit unserem Green Team bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich in Projekten zu Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz zu engagieren. Gemeinsam wollen wir unseren Beitrag leisten und den Planeten so positiv beeinflussen, wie wir nur können.

Flexibilität – Aktuell haben wir eine Regelung, die wöchentlich bis zu 20% mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ermöglicht. Dazu darfst Du 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Zusätzlich bieten wir 28 Urlaubstage. Pro Kalenderjahr kommen ein weiterer Urlaubstag hinzu (bis zu maximal 30 Tage) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe (z. B. Umzug, Mitarbeit an einem sozialen Projekt etc.).*

Modernes Büro - Wir haben ein eigenes und voll ausgestattetes Fitnessstudio, eine Dachterrasse für Team Events und Mittagspausen in der Sonne, sowie Zen Rooms, in denen Mitarbeitende beten, entspannen oder einfach eine ruhige Minute finden können.

Kostenloses Mittagessen - Wenn Du im Büro bist, bieten wir Dir verschiedene Optionen für ein Mittagessen an, und das Mittagessen geht auf uns! Du kannst in dem nahliegenden Partner-Restaurant essen gehen! Natürlich sind auch heiße sowie kalte Getränke, Obst und andere Snacks im Büro für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen kostenlos.*

Soziale Kultur - Ein gutes Miteinander ist uns wichtig, weshalb wir Wert auf eine Kultur legen, die dazu einlädt, miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen, gute Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und sich gemeinschaftlich an Projekten zu beteiligen. Wir bieten außerdem regelmäßig optionale Events an, um dies weiter zu unterstützen.

Partner für den Handel – Wir ermöglichen es Händler:innen, ihre Kund:innen auf die effizienteste und wirkungsvollste Weise zu erreichen. Wir sehen uns als wichtigen Geschäftspartner für den Handel und – wie in unserer Unternehmensvision betont – „Bereichern wir das lokale Einkaufen für alle. Jeden Tag.“

Hört sich das gut an für Dich? Wir freuen uns von Dir zu hören!

jobs.title: Performance Ad Creative – Static & Video
jobs.description:
Performance Ad Creative – Static & Video

Die Rolle

Du bist Performance Ad Creative in unserem Growth Team. Unsere Performance-Agentur steuert Strategie, Testplan und Media Buying auf Meta und TikTok. Du baust die Ads: Statics und Video, Hooks und Varianten, in wöchentlichen Sprints. Aus jedem Gewinner machst du die nächste Generation.

Dafür verbindest du Daten mit Kreativität. Du weißt, was im E-Commerce gerade funktioniert, liest die Zahlen deiner Ads und machst daraus die nächste Idee. Du entwickelst und produzierst selbst, von Konzept und Skript bis zum fertigen Asset.

Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Brand und Performance: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Creative Direction zusammen, nutzt die Bildwelt der Marke als Fundament und sorgst dafür, dass Qstar auch in schnellen Ads erkennbar bleibt. Im Growth Team arbeitest du mit Shop Lead, Creator Marketing und Organic Social zusammen und berichtest regelmäßig, welche Ads laufen, was gewinnt und was als Nächstes getestet wird.

Was du machst

  • Du baust unsere Performance-Creative-Pipeline auf: von Idee und Briefing über Produktion bis Test und Auswertung, als wiederholbaren Prozess.

  • Du arbeitest in Wochensprints: jede Woche neue Ads in den Test, müde Ads werden ersetzt.

  • Du entwickelst eigene Konzepte, Hooks und Formate für Meta und TikTok und baust Static- und Video-Ads selbst.

  • Du liest Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Watch Time, CTR, CPM, Conversion Rate, CPA und ROAS, leitest daraus ab, was als Nächstes getestet wird, und multiplizierst, was gewinnt.

  • Du arbeitest im Testplan der Agentur, bekommst ihre Learnings und lieferst, was sie zum Skalieren braucht.

  • Du arbeitest mit dem Material, das da ist: Brand-Shootings, Bewegtbild aus dem Creative Department, Creator- und UGC-Content. Du zeigst, wo Shootings oder weitere Produktionen nötig sind. Templates und AI-Workflows sorgen für Tempo.

  • Du bleibst am Puls: welche Formate im E-Commerce gerade performen, was die besten D2C-Brands machen. Dieses Wissen bringst du ins Team.

Was du mitbringst

  • Zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung im Bau von Performance-Ads im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, in einer Agentur, einer Brand oder als Freelancer.

  • Ein Portfolio mit echten Ads, die live waren. Du kannst erklären, warum sie funktioniert haben oder nicht.

  • Du denkst in Hooks, den ersten drei Sekunden und Varianten, nicht in Einzelstücken.

  • Sicher in Figma oder Adobe für Statics und in CapCut, Premiere oder After Effects für Video. AI-Tools gehören zu deinem Alltag.

  • Du kennst Meta und TikTok von innen: Formate, Specs, was im Feed funktioniert und warum beide Plattformen unterschiedlich ticken.

  • Du arbeitest gern in einem System, bist schnell und hast trotzdem ein Auge für Marke. Du sagst uns, wenn eine Ad performt, aber nicht nach Qstar aussieht.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Nutrition oder Supplements und ein Gefühl dafür, was bei Health Claims geht und was nicht. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Deutsch fließend (mindestens C1). Du arbeitest hybrid in Hamburg.

Was wir bieten

Eine Rolle, die es bei uns noch nicht gibt und die du von Anfang an prägst, mit einem Launch Anfang 2027 und einem Sortiment, das wächst. Du siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit in Zahlen bewegt. Direkter Draht zu Growth, Creative Direction und den Gründern. Budget für Tools. Ein Büro in Hamburg, das wir gerade zum Content-Studio ausbauen. Hybrides Arbeiten. 48.000 bis 58.000 € brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung. Und Produkte, die du selbst nutzen willst.

So läuft es

Ein erstes Gespräch mit Growth und Creative. Därt führst du uns durch dein Portfolio. Im zweiten Schritt stellst du uns vor, wie du ein Ad-System für Qstar aufbauen würdest. Diesen Case vergüten wir. Dann Kennenlernen im Team. Von der Bewerbung bis zur Entscheidung maximal drei Wochen.

Schick uns dein Portfolio mit Ads, die live waren, deinen Lebenslauf und drei Sätze zu einer Frage: Welche Ad aus deinem Feed hat dich zuletzt zum Kauf gebracht, und warum? Bewerbungen ohne Portfolio können wir nicht berücksichtigen.

jobs.title: Senior ALM Manager
jobs.description:
Senior ALM Manager

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

The Finance & Treasury function covers a broad spectrum of financial responsibilities for the Bank.

Under the leadership of the CFO and the finance department heads, the team is responsible for equity raising and investor relations; treasury and liquidity management; prudential risk and regulatory reporting; financial reporting and accounting, financial planning, and tax management activities.

We believe that freedom, autonomy, and trust bring the best out of people, so we work with team players who get the importance of owning their responsibilities but know the value of collaboration. We are curious, honest, and supportive.

Role Description

The Senior ALM Manager will be responsible for managing the bank’s balance sheet risks, with a particular focus on interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB), and market risk.

The role involves developing strategies to optimise hedging, while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk appetite.

The Senior ALM Manager will also play a key role in supporting ALCO decision-making by providing analysis, reporting, and recommendations.

Principal Accountabilities

Balance Sheet Management:

  • Monitor, measure, and manage structural risks in the balance sheet, including liquidity, funding, and IRRBB.

  • Develop and maintain structural hedging strategies.

  • Optimise asset-liability mismatches to support sustainable growth.

  • Interest Rate Risk:

  • Analyse repricing gaps and sensitivity of Net Interest Income (NII) and Economic Value of Equity (EVE).

  • Propose hedging strategies (derivatives, swaps, etc.) to manage structural interest rate exposures.

  • Ensure modelling assumptions (e.g., deposit behaviour, prepayment rates) remain robust and up to date.

Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP)

  • Support the design and maintenance of the FTP framework.

  • Provide recommendations to business lines on pricing and profitability.

Reporting & Governance

  • Produce regular ALM dashboards and reports for ALCO, Risk committees and regulators.

  • Present findings and recommendations to senior management.

  • Ensure compliance with PRA, BoE, and Basel regulatory requirements.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Treasury, Finance, Risk, and business lines to

  • Ensure alignment of strategies.

  • Contribute to stress testing, ICAAP, ILAAP, and Recovery & Resolution planning.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Strong understanding of balance sheet management, liquidity risk, IRRBB, and capital management.

  • Solid knowledge of PRA/BoE regulatory requirements (LCR, NSFR, IRRBB, ICAAP, ILAAP).

  • Experience with ALM modelling systems (e.g., QRM, Empyrean, Kamakura, Prometeia).

You’ll develop real-world skills and a mindset for excellence in execution.

You’ll gain hands-on experience, mentorship from top professionals, and the opportunity to make a tangible impact in one of Europe’s most advanced AI companies.

  • Freundlicher, professioneller Empfang und erste Ansprechperson für Patient*innen

  • Selbstständige Verwaltung des Terminwesens inkl. Konfliktlösung

  • Eigeninitiative sowie lösungsorientiertes und teamfähiges Arbeiten
