jobs.title: Operations Specialist, AI Enablement [Content Moderation]
jobs.description:
Operations Specialist, AI Enablement [Content Moderation]

Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Operations Specialist, AI Enablement to join our CX & Trust team. Trust, care, and high-quality experiences are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by improving how our AI-powered customer experience and moderation systems support our community.

You’ll evaluate AI-powered customer interactions and automated moderation decisions against Bumble’s policies, processes, and quality standards, helping us understand where our systems are performing well and where they can improve. Through quality reviews, accurate case labelling, golden-set maintenance, and thoughtful analysis, you’ll help ensure AI-supported decisions are consistent, precise, and grounded in the nuance required to serve our members responsibly. You’ll work closely with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager and colleagues across CX & Trust, taking ownership of high-quality work and demonstrating our Bumble values of Courage, Curiosity, Respect, and Excellence as we reimagine how AI can strengthen trust and care across the member experience.

This role will be based in London and will work in a hybrid model.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct quality reviews of AI-powered customer conversations and automated moderation decisions, assessing their alignment with Bumble’s community policies, operational processes, and quality standards.

  • Analyse policy enforcement gaps and nuanced cases, identifying where automated decisions may be inconsistent, unclear, or misaligned with policy intent and surfacing actionable insights for improvement.

  • Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance.

  • Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision.

  • Report quality issues through established workflows, taking ownership of accurate categorisation, clear documentation, and actionable feedback, and seeing insights through to meaningful impact.

  • Collaborate purposefully with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager on scoring consistency, calibration, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to strengthen AI reliability and the member experience.

  • Identify patterns and share learnings that can improve AI accuracy and precision, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency, approaching emerging challenges with Curiosity and an agile mindset.

  • Use QA platforms and AI-supported tools, including systems such as Cinder, Zendesk QA, and Bumble’s internal assessment tooling, to monitor quality and understand AI behaviour, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before acting on results.

About you

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience or transferable skills from Trust & Safety, content moderation, Customer Experience, quality assurance, or another fast-paced, policy-driven environment.

  • Have a sharp eye for detail and can objectively evaluate conversations, moderation decisions, and other interactions against established policies, processes, and quality standards.

  • Bring familiarity with conversational AI systems, chatbots, automated moderation, or AI-supported workflows, with the Curiosity to continue learning how these systems behave, where their limitations lie, and how human judgment can improve their effectiveness.

  • Understand, or are motivated to learn, quality assurance practices such as case labelling, calibration, consistent scoring, golden-set evaluation, and clear documentation of quality findings.

  • Are comfortable learning digital tools and platforms and can use data and quality insights to identify meaningful patterns while adapting your approach as systems, policies, and priorities evolve.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your deliverables, and see work through from insight to impact while welcoming feedback as an opportunity to learn and improve.

  • Apply AI thoughtfully and responsibly, assessing outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness rather than relying on them without review, and demonstrate Bumble’s values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and colleagues.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.
